lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常修饰 society, reform, economy 等词，指以农业为基础的或涉及土地所有权的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agrarian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: moving toward the north

examples.en: An accident has blocked two lanes of the northbound highway this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨一起事故阻塞了北行高速公路的两条车道。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语，修饰 lane, train, traffic 等交通相关名词，表示向北方向行驶的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 northbound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: spatially or metaphorically from a higher to a lower level or position

examples.en: She looked downwards to avoid making eye contact with the angry crowd.
examples.zh: 她低下头，避免与愤怒的人群发生眼神接触。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于英式英语，修饰 look, point, spiral 等动词，既指物理朝下，也常引申指数据或趋势下滑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downwards 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑术的, 马的, 骑在马背上的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or composed of knights

examples.en: The bronze equestrian statue of the general stands prominently in the center of the square.
examples.zh: 那位将军的青铜骑马雕像耸立在广场中央格外显眼。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，常修饰 statue（骑马雕像）、events/sports（马术比赛）或 skills（骑术）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equestrian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: again but in a new or different way

examples.en: After the fire destroyed their house, they were forced to begin anew.
examples.zh: 大火烧毁了他们的房屋后，他们不得不从头开始生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面用语，多放在动词后作状语，常与 start, begin, build 等搭配，强调推倒重来或以新方式开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经请求的, 主动提供的
lemmas.def_en: not asked for

examples.en: He was annoyed by the constant stream of unsolicited promotional emails in his inbox.
examples.zh: 收件箱里源源不断的不请自来的推销邮件让他感到十分烦躁。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语，修饰 advice, calls, emails, feedback 等，指未经请求主动送上门的，多带负面色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unsolicited 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infectious disease characterized by inflammation of the meninges (the tissues that surround the brain or spinal cord) usually caused by a bacterial infection; symptoms include headache and stiff neck and fever and nausea

examples.en: The child was rushed to the hospital with a high fever and later diagnosed with bacterial meningitis.
examples.zh: 孩子因高烧被紧急送往医院，随后被确诊为细菌性脑膜炎。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，医学专业与日常皆用，常见搭配如 bacterial/viral meningitis 及 contract meningitis。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meningitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant having a large edible head of crowded white flower buds

examples.en: She chopped the cauliflower into small florets before roasting them with olive oil.
examples.zh: 她把花椰菜切成小朵，然后拌上橄榄油进行烘烤。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作不可数名词指蔬菜，个体化时可数；常见搭配如 roasted cauliflower、cauliflower florets 等烹饪语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cauliflower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无赖, 游民, 游荡者
lemmas.def_en: an experience that is irritating or frustrating or disappointing

examples.en: He turned out to be a lazy bummer who refused to look for a job.
examples.zh: 结果证明他是个游手好闲的懒汉，根本不愿去找工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式俚语，常作单数与 a 连用表示令人失望的人或事，亦可指游民或赖皮；语气轻松口语化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bummer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an organization

examples.en: Her exceptional organisational skills made the large-scale international conference a huge success.
examples.zh: 她出色的组织能力使这场大型国际会议取得了巨大成功。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式拼写（美式为 organizational），常修饰 skills, structure, culture，多用于商务与职场语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 organisational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen

examples.en: We usually spend Sunday evenings relaxing on the sofa and watching the telly.
examples.zh: 我们周日晚上通常都坐在沙发上看电视放松。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式口语高频词，等同于 television，常与介词 on 连用（如 on the telly）或搭配 watch the telly。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喇叭边(或号角)嘹亮吹奏声, 吹牛
lemmas.def_en: a gaudy outward display

examples.en: The new smartphone was launched with great fanfare at an exclusive press event.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机在一场盛大的专场媒体发布会上高调亮相。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指军号齐鸣的乐声，也常引申为高调宣扬、大张旗鼓；常见搭配如 with/without great fanfare。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fanfare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several forms of ulcerative skin disease

examples.en: Patients living with lupus often experience chronic fatigue and joint pain.
examples.zh: 红斑狼疮患者经常会经历慢性疲劳和关节疼痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学名词，作不可数名词，多指自身免疫性疾病（系统性红斑狼疮）；常见搭配如 suffer from lupus。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lupus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thin coagulable fluid (similar to plasma but) containing white blood cells (lymphocytes) and chyle; is conveyed to the blood stream by lymphatic vessels

examples.en: Clear lymph fluid circulates through the tissues to help remove cellular waste.
examples.zh: 清澈的淋巴液在组织间循环流动，有助于清除细胞代谢废物。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖与生理学名词，指淋巴液，为不可数名词；常见复合词包括 lymph node（淋巴结）、lymph vessel。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or produced by lymph

examples.en: The lymphatic system plays an essential role in defending against bodily infections.
examples.zh: 淋巴系统在抵御体内感染方面起着至关重要的作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lymph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a victory cheer

examples.en: A loud hooray rose from the crowd as the winning goal was scored.
examples.zh: 当决胜球打入时，人群中爆发出一阵响亮的欢呼声。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词用法指欢呼声或喝彩声，可数名词；常与 give, raise 搭配（如 give three hoorays）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hooray 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可叹的, 悲惨的, 凄惨的
lemmas.def_en: bad; unfortunate

examples.en: The refugees were forced to live in deplorable conditions with barely any clean water.
examples.zh: 难民们被迫生活在极其恶劣的条件中，几乎没有干净的饮用水。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语形容词，意为极糟糕的、令人愤慨的；常修饰 conditions, behaviour, state of affairs。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deplorable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 救火队员, 消防队员
lemmas.def_en: play in which children pretend to put out a fire

examples.en: A brave fireman rushed into the burning building to rescue the trapped child.
examples.zh: 一名勇敢的消防员冲进起火的大楼，救出了被困的孩子。

lemmas.usage_note: 指职业消防员，现代英美更倾向于使用中性词 firefighter；常与 volunteer 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fireman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a period of time when something (as a machine or factory) is not operating (especially as a result of malfunctions)

examples.en: The IT team scheduled the server maintenance overnight to minimize system downtime.
examples.zh: IT团队将服务器维护安排在夜间进行，以尽量减少系统停机时间。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要用于 IT 和工业领域指设备停机时间，也可非正式指个人的休息放松时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式放弃；退位, 退出, 辞职
lemmas.def_en: give up, such as power, as of monarchs and emperors, or duties and obligations

examples.en: The monarch decided to abdicate the throne in favor of his eldest son.
examples.zh: 君主决定退位，让位于他的长子。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，及物时常接 throne 表示退位，或接 responsibility/duty 表示放弃履行职责。

lemmas.def_zh: 逊位, 弃权, 辞职
lemmas.def_en: a formal resignation and renunciation of powers

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abdicate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 空谈的, 不实际的, 柏拉图哲学的, 柏拉图的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of Plato or his philosophy

examples.en: Despite rumors, they insisted that their relationship was purely platonic.
examples.zh: 尽管外界传言纷纷，他们坚称彼此之间只是纯粹的精神友谊。

lemmas.usage_note: 常首字母大写或小写，最常修饰 relationship/love/friendship，指纯精神层面、非肉欲的纯洁关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 platonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波尔卡舞, 女用紧身短上衣
lemmas.def_en: music performed for dancing the polka

examples.en: The brass band struck up a lively polka, and couples quickly took to the dance floor.
examples.zh: 铜管乐队奏起了欢快的波尔卡舞曲，一对对舞伴迅速走上了舞池。

lemmas.usage_note: 指起源于波希米亚的快步双人舞或其舞曲，常与 dance 搭配，衍生复合词 polka dot（圆点花纹）极常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the second pillar of Islam is prayer; a prescribed liturgy performed five times a day (preferably in a mosque) and oriented toward Mecca

examples.en: Devout Muslims gather at the mosque five times a day to perform the salah.
examples.zh: 虔诚的穆斯林每天在清真寺聚集五次进行礼拜。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教专有名词，指伊斯兰教每日必做的五次礼拜仪式，常与 perform 或 observe 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的
lemmas.def_en: acceptable to the taste or mind

examples.en: The chef managed to make the bitter medicinal herbs surprisingly palatable.
examples.zh: 主厨想方设法让这种苦味草药变得出奇的可口。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指食物“美味可口”，亦常引申为方案、提议“令人满意的、易于接受的”，后常接介词 to。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可口的, 味道差的, 不好吃的
lemmas.def_en: not pleasant or acceptable to the taste or mind

examples.en: an unpalatable meal
unpalatable truths

lemmas.def_zh: 嗜食性, 适口性, 风味
lemmas.def_en: the property of being acceptable to the mouth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palatable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a site where people on holiday can pitch a tent

examples.en: We pitched our tent near the lake as soon as we arrived at the campground.
examples.zh: 我们一到达露营地，就在湖边搭起了帐篷。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于北美英语（英式多用 campsite），指配备露营设施的场地，常作可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 campground 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 等位基因, 对偶基因
lemmas.def_en: (genetics) either of a pair (or series) of alternative forms of a gene that can occupy the same locus on a particular chromosome and that control the same character

examples.en: A child inherits one allele for eye color from each biological parent.
examples.zh: 孩子从亲生父母双方各继承一个决定眼睛颜色的等位基因。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学专业术语，指同一基因座上的变异形式，常与 dominant（显性）或 recessive（隐性）搭配。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to alleles

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allele 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: deep ditch cut by running water (especially after a prolonged downpour)

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains quickly transformed the dry gully into a rushing torrent.
examples.zh: 猛烈的季风降雨迅速将干涸的冲沟变成了一条奔腾的洪流。

lemmas.usage_note: 指雨水冲刷形成的小峡谷、冲沟，或指路边的排水沟；复数形式为 gullies。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gully 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: silky envelope spun by the larvae of many insects to protect pupas and by spiders to protect eggs

examples.en: The caterpillar spun a silky cocoon around itself before beginning its transformation.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫在开始蜕变之前，用丝为自己结了一个茧。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指蚕等昆虫所吐的茧，引申指保护性外壳；常见搭配如 spin a cocoon 或 a cocoon of safety。

lemmas.def_en: retreat as if into a cocoon, as from an unfriendly environment

examples.en: She cocooned herself in a thick wool blanket to escape the winter chill.
examples.zh: 她用厚厚的羊毛毯将自己紧紧裹住，以躲避冬日的严寒。

lemmas.usage_note: 意为紧紧包裹或提供庇护，常与介词 in 或 from 连用，多含舒适、隔绝外界之意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Greek mathematician and inventor who devised a way to determine the area of a triangle and who described various mechanical devices (first century)

examples.en: A grey heron stood motionless in the shallow water, waiting for fish to pass by.
examples.zh: 一只苍鹭一动不动地伫立在浅水中，等待着游鱼经过。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指涉水长颈鸟类苍鹭；常作主语搭配 stand, wade, fish 等动作动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: formulate in a particular style or language

examples.en: The department agreed to release the report, but decided to redact all personal names.
examples.zh: 该部门同意公布该报告，但决定隐去所有个人姓名。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于法律与政府语境，指为保护机密而删改、隐去文件中敏感信息；常作及物动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 编辑, 校订本, 修订
lemmas.def_en: putting something (as a literary work or a legislative bill) into acceptable form
someone who puts text into appropriate form for publication

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redact 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使断奶, 使丢弃, 使断念
lemmas.def_en: gradually deprive (infants and young mammals) of mother's milk

examples.en: The doctor helped him gradually wean himself off the heavy painkillers.
examples.zh: 医生帮助他逐渐戒掉了对烈性止痛药的依赖。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指使婴儿或幼崽断奶，也常以 wean sb off/from sth 形式表示戒除恶习或摆脱依赖。

lemmas.def_zh: 尚未断奶的, 还在吃奶的
lemmas.def_en: not weaned

examples.en: some children remain unweaned until their second or third birthdays

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纱锭, 纺锤, 轴, 心轴
lemmas.def_en: (biology) tiny fibers that are seen in cell division; the fibers radiate from two poles and meet at the equator in the middle

examples.en: The wool thread snapped when the spindle suddenly stopped rotating.
examples.zh: 当纱锭突然停止旋转时，毛线应声而断。

lemmas.usage_note: 机械与纺织术语，指纱锭、心轴或回转轴；常见搭配如 spindle motor（主轴电机）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spindle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a list of dishes available at a restaurant

examples.en: Guests can choose the fixed-price banquet or order dishes directly from the carte.
examples.zh: 客人可以选择固定价格的宴席，也可以直接按菜单单点菜品。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语，多用于餐饮语境指菜单，最常出现在固定搭配 à la carte（按菜单单点）中。

lemmas.def_en: draw slowly or heavily

examples.en: The police arrived quickly and carted the protesters away in a van.
examples.zh: 警察迅速赶到，并用面包车把抗议者强行运走了。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，意为用车运送或费力搬运，常与 off, away 等副词搭配，多含强迫或费劲意味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an automaton that resembles a human being

examples.en: The laboratory unveiled an advanced humanoid capable of complex facial expressions.
examples.zh: 实验室展示了一款能够做出复杂面部表情的先进人形机器人。

lemmas.usage_note: 科幻与机器人学名词，指外形具人类特征的生物或类人机器人；常作主语或宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humanoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a nonmetallic element belonging to the halogens; used especially in medicine and photography and in dyes; occurs naturally only in combination in small quantities (as in sea water or rocks)

examples.en: The nurse applied some iodine to clean the wound before bandaging it.
examples.zh: 护士在包扎伤口前涂抹了一些碘酒来进行消毒。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指化学元素碘或医用消毒碘酒；常见搭配如 tincture of iodine（碘酒）。

lemmas.def_en: cause to combine with iodine

examples.en: iodinate thyroxine

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iodine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the expulsion of an ovum from the ovary (usually midway in the menstrual cycle)

lemmas.def_zh: 卵, 卵子, 卵形装饰
lemmas.def_en: the female reproductive cell; the female gamete

examples.en: A single sperm cell penetrates the protective outer layer to fertilize the ovum.
examples.zh: 单个精子穿透保护性外层，使卵细胞受精。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学专业名词，指成熟的卵细胞；复数形式为 ova，常见搭配如 fertilize an ovum。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 原卵, 卵泡内卵, 卵状小体, 小卵
lemmas.def_en: a small body that contains the female germ cell of a plant; develops into a seed after fertilization

examples.en: After successful pollination, the plant ovule gradually develops into a seed.
examples.zh: 成功授粉后，植物的胚珠会逐渐发育成种子。

lemmas.def_en: produce and discharge eggs

examples.en: women ovulate about once every month

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ovum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hand tool for driving screws; has a tip that fits into the head of a screw

examples.en: He grabbed a Phillips screwdriver from his toolbox to tighten the loose cabinet handle.
examples.zh: 他从工具箱里拿出一把十字螺丝刀，拧紧了松动的橱柜把手。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指手工具螺丝刀，或指伏特加加橙汁调制的鸡尾酒；常见搭配 flathead/Phillips screwdriver。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 screwdriver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽；贪食, 咯咯叫
lemmas.def_en: eat hastily without proper chewing

examples.en: Starving after the long hike, he gobbled down the entire pizza in minutes.
examples.zh: 长途徒步后饥肠辘辘的他几分钟内就把整张披萨狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 down 或 up 连用，形容贪婪、急促地吞食；亦可指火鸡发出的特征叫声，多用于非正式口语。

lemmas.def_en: a hasty eater who swallows large mouthfuls

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gobble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coordinate in such a way that all parts work together effectively

examples.en: The security system consists of several interlocking mechanisms that prevent unauthorized access.
examples.zh: 该安全系统由几个互相咬合的联动机制组成，以防止未经授权的进入。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物也可作不及物动词，常与 with 连用，描述齿轮、部件或事件紧密咬合、环环相扣。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 互锁的；连锁的；交错结合的
lemmas.def_en: connecting together securely like the parts of a jigsaw puzzle; closely joined
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰几何结构、拼图、齿轮或抽象的复杂系统，如 interlocking pieces / directorates。

examples.en: The puzzle consists of twenty interlocking wooden pieces.
examples.zh: 这个拼图由二十块相互咬合的木块组成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interlock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one thousandth (1/1,000) gram

examples.en: The doctor advised her to take a daily dose of 200 milligrams of vitamin C.
examples.zh: 医生建议她每天服用200毫克的维生素C。

lemmas.usage_note: 常缩写为 mg，多用于医学、化学和营养学语境，精确表示药物剂量或微量成分的质量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milligram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 八音度, 低八度音, 高八度音
lemmas.def_en: a feast day and the seven days following it

examples.en: She effortlessly sang the chorus an octave higher than the original recording.
examples.zh: 她毫不费力地把副歌唱得比原版录音高了一个八度。

lemmas.usage_note: 音乐专用名词，常搭配 drop an octave（降八度）或 an octave higher（高八度），指相隔八度的音程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 octave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩水, 拨弄, 涉猎；溅湿
lemmas.def_en: dip a foot or hand briefly into a liquid

examples.en: He dabbed in landscape painting for a few months before losing interest.
examples.zh: 他涉足风景画创作了几个月，随后便失去了兴趣。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 in 连用表示浅尝辄止地涉猎某领域；与 with 连用或作不及物表示在水中戏水玩耍。

lemmas.def_en: an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dabble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铁手套, 长手套, 夹击
lemmas.def_en: to offer or accept a challenge

examples.en: To enter the press conference, the politician had to run the gauntlet of angry protesters.
examples.zh: 为了进入新闻发布会，这位政客不得不经受愤怒抗议者的重重包围与质问。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于固定成语，如 throw down the gauntlet（发起挑战）或 run the gauntlet（经受严峻考验）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gauntlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新开动, 再度上演
lemmas.def_en: broadcast again, as of a film

examples.en: The network decided to rerun the popular documentary series during prime time.
examples.zh: 电视台决定在黄金时段重播这部备受欢迎的纪录片系列。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接 film、series 或 experiment 作宾语，指重新放映影视作品或重做测试与实验。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rerun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female ballet dancer

examples.en: The young ballerina captivated the entire audience with her graceful pirouettes.
examples.zh: 年轻的芭蕾舞女演员以其优雅的单足旋转征服了全场观众。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指女性芭蕾舞演员，高级别首席常称 prima ballerina，多用于艺术表演与舞蹈评论语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballerina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食人魔鬼, 怪物, 象鬼的人, 可怕的东西
lemmas.def_en: a cruel wicked and inhuman person

examples.en: The strict director was treated like an ogre by the terrified junior staff.
examples.zh: 那位严苛的主管被吓坏了的初级员工们视作可怕的怪物。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为神话中的食人怪物，口语和文学中常借指残暴可怕、令人望而生畏的人，如专横的上司。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ogre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大人物, 有权势的人
lemmas.def_en: a bump on a ski slope

examples.en: The media mogul recently acquired several regional newspaper publishing companies.
examples.zh: 这位传媒巨头最近收购了数家地区性报纸出版公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 media、business、tech 等行业词搭配，指在某一商业领域拥有巨大资本与影响力的巨头或大亨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mogul 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 叫喊, 发牢骚, 抱怨；大声叫喊
lemmas.def_en: shout out

examples.en: He hollered at the kids to stop playing so close to the busy street.
examples.zh: 他冲着孩子们大喊，让他们别在车流密集的街道旁玩耍。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式非正式用语，常与 at、out 连用，表示高声呼喊或因不满而抱怨抗议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: composed of distinct particles

examples.en: High concentrations of particulate matter pose severe risks to public health.
examples.zh: 高浓度的颗粒物对公众健康构成了严重威胁。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于环境科学与物理学，常修饰 matter, pollution 等，指由微小颗粒构成的。

lemmas.def_en: a small discrete mass of solid or liquid matter that remains individually dispersed in gas or liquid emissions (usually considered to be an atmospheric pollutant)

examples.en: The industrial filters are designed to capture airborne particulates before emission.
examples.zh: 这些工业过滤器旨在排放前捕集空气中的悬浮颗粒物。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作复数形式 particulates，特指空气或液体中悬浮的微小固体或液体微粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 particulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to seem less serious; play down

examples.en: You shouldn't belittle her achievements just because you disagree with her methods.
examples.zh: 你不能仅因不同意她的方法就贬低她的成就。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接人或其成就、努力作宾语，表示贬低、看轻以削弱其重要性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belittle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a narrowing that reduces the flow through a channel

examples.en: A lack of skilled technicians has become the main bottleneck in our production line.
examples.zh: 缺乏技术熟练的工人已成为我们生产线上的主要瓶颈。

lemmas.usage_note: 比喻用法，常指交通受阻路段或生产流程中限制整体效率的“瓶颈”环节。

lemmas.def_en: slow down or impede by creating an obstruction

examples.en: Heavy traffic bottlenecked the bridge, causing severe delays for commuters.
examples.zh: 拥堵的交通阻塞了桥梁，导致通勤人员严重延误。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指交通或工序受阻、放缓，常用于被动语态或描述系统迟滞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bottleneck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯
lemmas.def_en: a clause in a contract that provides for an increase or a decrease in wages or prices or benefits etc. depending on certain conditions (as a change in the cost of living index)

examples.en: We took the escalator up to the third floor to visit the electronics section.
examples.zh: 我们乘自动扶梯上到三楼去逛电子产品区。

lemmas.usage_note: 指商场或车站等处的自动扶梯；商业中也可喻指合同里的自动调整条款（escalator clause）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 escalator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可实施的, 可强行的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being enforced

examples.en: Without a written signature, the verbal agreement may not be legally enforceable.
examples.zh: 没有亲笔签名，这项口头协议可能不具备法律上的强制执行力。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与正式语体常用词，常修饰 contract, law, right 等，表示具备法律效力且可强行实施的。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不能强制的, 不能执行的, 不能实行的
lemmas.def_en: not enforceable; not capable of being brought about by compulsion

examples.en: an unenforceable law
unenforceable reforms

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enforceable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 驱使过度, 使工作过度
lemmas.def_en: drive or work too hard

examples.en: The manager overdrove the project team to meet the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 经理为了赶上紧迫的截止日期而过度驱使项目团队。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指过度驱使牲畜、劳工或机械设备，使其超负荷运转而受损。

lemmas.def_en: drive or work too hard

examples.en: Workers who are chronically overdriven often suffer from severe burnout.
examples.zh: 长期被过度役使的员工常常会遭受严重的职业倦怠。

examples.en: The aging engine had been overdriven for hours before it finally overheated.
examples.zh: 这台老化的发动机在连续超负荷运转数小时后终于过热了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overdrive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中性的, 不及物的, 生殖器不完全的
lemmas.def_en: of grammatical gender

examples.en: In German grammar, nouns can be masculine, feminine, or neuter.
examples.zh: 在德语语法中，名词可以是阳性、阴性或中性。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法中指“中性的”；生物学中指“无性别的”或工蜂等“无生殖能力的”。

lemmas.def_en: remove the ovaries of

examples.en: The veterinarian advised us to neuter our puppy before he reaches six months of age.
examples.zh: 兽医建议我们在小狗满六个月之前带它去做绝育。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常指给宠物绝育（去势或切除卵巢）；引申指剥夺政治、法律等效力。

lemmas.def_zh: 阉割, 删除, 使丧失力量(或效果)
lemmas.def_en: deprive of strength or vigor

examples.en: The committee voted to castrate the bill by removing all its key enforcement provisions.
examples.zh: 委员会投票删除了该法案的所有关键执行条款，使其丧失了效力。

lemmas.def_zh: 去雄蕊, 修正, 阉割
lemmas.def_en: neutering a male animal by removing the testicles

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neuter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小软团, 小软块, 一卷, 填料, 大量
lemmas.def_en: a small mass of soft material

examples.en: He pulled a thick wad of banknotes out of his jacket pocket to pay the bill.
examples.zh: 他从夹克口袋里掏出一大卷厚厚的纸币来付账。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 a wad of (cash/cotton/paper)，指搓成一团或卷成一卷的软质小物件或大笔钞票。

lemmas.def_en: compress into a wad

examples.en: Frustrated with the draft, she wadded up the letter and threw it into the trash.
examples.zh: 她对初稿感到沮丧，把信纸揉成一团扔进了垃圾桶。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 up 连用，表示将纸张、布料揉成团，或用填料塞紧、衬垫某物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 列举, 计算, 枚举, 数
lemmas.def_en: specify individually

examples.en: The report enumerates the major challenges facing the company in the next decade.
examples.zh: 该报告详细列举了公司在未来十年面临的主要挑战。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，及物动词，指按次序一一列举、详细点清理由、事实或清单条目。

lemmas.def_zh: 计算, 列举, 细目
lemmas.def_en: a numbered list
someone who collects census data by visiting individual homes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enumerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: decrease gradually or bit by bit

examples.en: The government decided to pare down its military spending to support public healthcare.
examples.zh: 政府决定削减军费开支以支持公共医疗。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于及物动词，指削去皮或修剪边缘，引申为消减开支、预算，常与 down 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 重新传输的肯定回答
lemmas.def_en: make a score (on a hole) equal to par

examples.en: The receiving node will par the packet once the integrity verification is complete.
examples.zh: 一旦完整性验证完成，接收节点就会对该数据包做出肯定确认。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机通信术语，特指对重新传输请求给予肯定应答确认，属于专业工程口吻。

lemmas.def_zh: 削皮的人, 削皮刀, 削皮器
lemmas.def_en: a manicurist who trims the fingernails

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an indistinct shapeless form

examples.en: She squeezed a generous blob of toothpaste onto her brush.
examples.zh: 她挤了一大坨牙膏在牙刷上。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指黏稠液体的小滴或无定形的小团块，常见于描述颜料、墨水或半流体物。

lemmas.def_en: make a spot or mark onto

examples.en: Be careful not to blob wet ink across your freshly written notes.
examples.zh: 小心别把湿墨水溅污在刚写好的笔记上。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示用黏稠液体滴落、涂抹或溅污表面，多用于工艺与书写语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any chamber that is connected to other chambers or passageways (especially one of the two upper chambers of the heart)

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the glass ceiling into the building's central atrium.
examples.zh: 阳光透过玻璃天花板倾泻进大楼中央的中庭。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，建筑学中指带天窗的挑高中庭，解剖学中指心脏的心房（左心房/右心房）。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a cavity or chamber in the body (especially one of the upper chambers of the heart)

examples.en: Doctors monitored the patient closely for symptoms of dangerous atrial fibrillation.
examples.zh: 医生密切监测该患者是否有危险的心房颤动症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 atrium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence

examples.en: One inevitable byproduct of heavy industrialization is increased environmental pollution.
examples.zh: 重度工业化的一个不可避免的副产品就是环境污染的加剧。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指工业制造过程中的次生副产物，或某种行为、决策意外带来的副带结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 byproduct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: frothy drink of milk and flavoring and sometimes fruit or ice cream

examples.en: He ordered a large chocolate milkshake along with his burger and fries.
examples.zh: 他点了一大杯巧克力奶昔，还配了汉堡和薯条。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，指由牛奶、冰淇淋和调味糖浆调制而成的奶昔冷饮，生活常用口语词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milkshake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微生物, 微小动植物
lemmas.def_en: any organism of microscopic size

examples.en: Beneficial microorganisms play a crucial role in maintaining healthy soil ecosystems.
examples.zh: 有益微生物在维持健康的土壤生态系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学可数名词，指肉眼不可见的细菌、病毒等微小生命体，多见于科研学术文体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microorganism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a crystalline rock that can be cut and polished for jewelry

examples.en: The artisan carefully set the rare blue gemstone into a platinum ring.
examples.zh: 工匠小心翼翼地将这颗罕见的蓝色宝石镶嵌在铂金戒指上。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指经切割、打磨后用于制作首饰的贵重矿石宝石，如钻石、红宝石等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gemstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侯尔（希伯来早期量具名）
lemmas.def_en: an ancient Hebrew unit of capacity equal to 10 baths or 10 ephahs

examples.en: The ancient tax record stated that each landowner owed ten kors of wheat.
examples.zh: 古代税务记录表明，每位地主需缴纳十侯尔的小麦。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，古希伯来及圣经历史语境下的传统容量单位（侯尔），专用于量度谷物或液体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发粘的, 破烂的, 俗丽的
lemmas.def_en: (of a glutinous liquid such as paint) not completely dried and slightly sticky to the touch

examples.en: The souvenir shop was filled with tacky plastic trinkets for tourists.
examples.zh: 那家纪念品商店里摆满了供游客购买的俗气塑料小玩意儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作非正式形容词，既可指漆或胶未干时的黏手状态，也可贬指服饰摆设俗气、粗陋。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being cohesive and sticky

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tacky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 密友, 亲密伙伴, 好朋友
lemmas.def_en: a close friend who accompanies his buddies in their activities

examples.en: The corrupt official distributed lucrative government contracts only to his political cronies.
examples.zh: 该腐败官员只将利润丰厚的政府合同分发给自己的政治亲信。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常含贬义，指长期私交甚笃的密友或死党，高频见于政治语境（如裙带资本主义）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: surrender under agreed conditions

examples.en: After weeks of intense public pressure, the government finally capitulated to the demands of the protesters.
examples.zh: 在数周强烈的公众压力下，政府最终向抗议者的诉求妥协。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词 to 表示向某人或某种压力妥协、认输，常用于正式政治、军事或辩论语境。

lemmas.def_zh: (有条件)投降, 投降书, 条约
lemmas.def_en: a document containing the terms of surrender

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capitulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sluggish tailless Australian arboreal marsupial with grey furry ears and coat; feeds on eucalyptus leaves and bark

examples.en: The koala spent most of the afternoon sleeping high up in the branches of the eucalyptus tree.
examples.zh: 那只考拉大半个下午都高高地睡在桉树的枝桠上。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常称作 koala bear，多与 eucalyptus（桉树）、native to 等词搭配，用于自然生态和日常语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 koala 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person holding a fief; a person who owes allegiance and service to a feudal lord

examples.en: In medieval Europe, a vassal swore loyalty and military support to his lord in exchange for land.
examples.zh: 在中世纪欧洲，封臣向领主宣誓效忠并提供军事支持，以换取土地。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指封建封臣；现代常作比喻用（如 vassal state 附庸国），含贬义，指任人摆布的附庸或下属。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vassal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长牙, 獠牙, 尖物
lemmas.def_en: a hard smooth ivory colored dentine that makes up most of the tusks of elephants and walruses

examples.en: The old elephant displayed a massive ivory tusk that curved gracefully upward.
examples.zh: 这头老象露出了一根优雅向上弯曲的巨大象牙。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指大象、海象等的长牙或獠牙，常与 ivory、poaching 等词搭配，多见于野生动物保护话题。

lemmas.def_zh: 以长牙刺戳, 以长牙掘
lemmas.def_en: stab or pierce with a horn or tusk

examples.en: Enraged by the predator, the wild boar charged forward and tusked the rival's flank.
examples.zh: 野猪被捕食者激怒，猛冲向前并用獠牙刺穿了对手的侧腹。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指用獠牙顶撞、刺穿或拱掘地面，常见于动物行为描写等叙述语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tusk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a reeling sensation; a feeling that you are about to fall

examples.en: Standing at the edge of the steep cliff induced a sudden, overwhelming bout of vertigo.
examples.zh: 站在陡峭的悬崖边缘引发了一阵突如其来且无法抗拒的眩晕。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词（有时加不定冠词），指因高处或内耳失衡引起的眩晕感，常与 suffer from、induce 等动词连用。

lemmas.def_en: having or causing a whirling sensation; liable to falling

examples.en: had a dizzy spell
a dizzy pinnacle

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vertigo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 土窖, 地穴, 地下室
lemmas.def_en: a cellar or vault or underground burial chamber (especially beneath a church)

examples.en: Several ancient bishops were laid to rest inside the damp, dimly lit crypt beneath the cathedral.
examples.zh: 几位古代主教安息在大教堂下方潮湿、昏暗的地下墓穴中。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，尤指教堂地下室或墓穴，常搭配 buried in、cathedral 等词，多出现于历史、建筑及宗教语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crypt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 莫霍克族, 莫霍克语, 前刃变后刃溜冰半周跳
lemmas.def_en: a member of the Iroquoian people formerly living along the Mohawk River in New York State

examples.en: The punk rock singer dyed his tall mohawk bright neon green before taking the stage.
examples.zh: 这位朋克摇滚歌手在上台前将他高耸的莫霍克发型染成了鲜艳的荧光绿。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指莫霍克发型（两侧剃光、中间直立）；首字母大写时指北美原住民族群或语言，多见于流行文化或历史语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mohawk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: repeat an earlier theme of a composition

examples.en: The defeated general sought to reprize his lost territories through a surprise counteroffensive.
examples.zh: 战败的将领试图通过一次突袭反攻来夺回他失去的领土。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，古义或罕用义指报复、重夺，现代英语中多作为 reprise 的变体使用（指重演或重复），语体较正式罕见。

lemmas.def_en: repeat an earlier theme of a composition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reprize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恢复, 使复原, 使恢复健康, 使恢复精神；复原, 恢复健康, 挽回损失
lemmas.def_en: regain or make up for

examples.en: The doctor advised him to rest at home for two weeks to fully recuperate from the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生建议他在家休息两周，以便从手术中完全康复。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不及物动词，常与 from 搭配表示从疾病、手术或经济损失中康复复原；作及物动词指收回（资金等），较正式。

lemmas.def_en: gradual healing (through rest) after sickness or injury

lemmas.def_zh: 恢复的, 有恢复力的
lemmas.def_en: promoting recuperation

examples.en: recuperative powers
strongly recuperative remedies

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recuperate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of a set of parallel slats in a door or window to admit air and reject rain

examples.en: He adjusted the angled louver on the window to let in fresh air while blocking the afternoon glare.
examples.zh: 他调整了窗户上的倾斜百叶板，以便透入新鲜空气，同时阻挡午后的强光。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（常作复数 louvers），指建筑或器械上的百叶片、天窗百叶排气孔，常用于建筑工程与家居装修语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 louver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: development of excess fibrous connective tissue in an organ

examples.en: Pulmonary fibrosis causes progressive scarring of the lung tissue, leading to severe shortness of breath.
examples.zh: 肺纤维化会导致肺组织逐渐结疤，进而引发严重的呼吸困难。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业名词，不可数，常与cystic（囊性）、pulmonary（肺）等形容词搭配，表示器官组织的病理性纤维化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fibrosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is a stupid incompetent fool

examples.en: The cuckoo is well known for laying its eggs in the nests of other birds.
examples.zh: 杜鹃鸟因将卵产在其他鸟类的巢中而广为人知。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指杜鹃鸟，亦可在口语中指疯子或傻瓜；常见搭配有cuckoo clock（布谷鸟挂钟）。

lemmas.def_en: repeat monotonously, like a cuckoo repeats his call

examples.en: A solitary bird cuckooed softly from the depths of the pine forest.
examples.zh: 一只落单的鸟儿在松林深处轻声咕咕啼叫。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指发出布谷鸟的叫声，或比喻性地指机械、单调且令人厌烦地重复某句话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuckoo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 求爱, 求婚, 求爱时期
lemmas.def_en: a man's courting of a woman; seeking the affections of a woman (usually with the hope of marriage)

examples.en: After a brief courtship of only three months, the couple decided to get married.
examples.zh: 在经历了短短三个月的求爱期后，这对新人便决定结婚。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指人类传统的恋爱追求期，也可指动物的求偶行为；常与display（展示）、ritual（仪式）连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 courtship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a semiaquatic reptile of Central and South America that resembles an alligator but has a more heavily armored belly

examples.en: A large black cayman was spotted lurking silently just beneath the surface of the river.
examples.zh: 有人发现一条巨大的黑凯门鳄悄无声息地潜伏在河面下。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（亦拼作caiman），指主要分布于中美洲和南美洲的凯门鳄属爬行动物，常用于动物学或生态报道中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cayman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 节制饮酒, 戒酒, 节制, 一本正经, 庄重
lemmas.def_en: the state of being sober and not intoxicated by alcohol

examples.en: He celebrated five years of complete sobriety and dedicated himself to helping other addicts.
examples.zh: 他庆祝了自己彻底戒酒的第五年，并致力于帮助其他成瘾者。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要指戒酒状态或清醒状态，亦可引申为言行的严肃庄重；常见搭配有sobriety test（呼气测醉试验）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sobriety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: signs collectively (especially commercial signs or posters)

examples.en: Clear bilingual signage was installed throughout the airport to guide international passengers.
examples.zh: 整个机场都安装了清晰的双语标识，用以引导国际旅客。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数集体名词，指公共场所的标志、标牌系统；常与clear（清晰的）、digital（电子的）等词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of money in Uzbekistan

examples.en: The transmission protocol checks for a valid SOM byte before processing the payload data.
examples.zh: 传输协议在处理有效载荷数据之前，会先检查是否存在有效的报文起始字符。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机通信专业缩写名词（Start of Message），指报文或消息的起始标志；也可指中亚国家的货币单位索姆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 som 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地基, 基础, 根据
lemmas.def_en: the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained

examples.en: Years of basic scientific research laid the groundwork for this medical breakthrough.
examples.zh: 多年的基础科学研究为这一医学突破奠定了坚实的基础。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，比喻筹备阶段的铺垫工作；极高频搭配为lay the groundwork for/of sth（为……奠定基础）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groundwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无忧无虑的, 不负责的
lemmas.def_en: free of trouble and worry and care

examples.en: The children spent a carefree afternoon splashing water and building sandcastles at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海滩上戏水、筑沙堡，度过了一个无忧无虑的下午。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰youth（青春）、days（岁月）、attitude（态度）等，描绘无忧无虑、无牵无挂的心境或生活状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carefree 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 个人主义, 个人特征
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being individual

examples.en: Western culture traditionally places a strong emphasis on individualism and personal autonomy.
examples.zh: 西方文化传统上极力强调个人主义与个人自主性。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，哲学与社会学术语，强调个人自由独立与独创性；常与rugged（强调自我奋斗的）连用，与collectivism相对。

lemmas.def_zh: 个人主义者, 利己主义者
lemmas.def_en: a person who pursues independent thought or action

examples.en: As an unrepentant individualist, she refused to follow any modern fashion trends.
examples.zh: 作为一个执着的个人主义者，她拒绝追随任何现代时尚潮流。

lemmas.def_zh: 个人主义的, 独特的
lemmas.def_en: marked by or expressing individuality

examples.en: an individualistic way of dressing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 individualism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可感知的, 明显的, 触摸得到的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being perceived; especially capable of being handled or touched or felt

examples.en: There was a palpable sense of relief in the room when the missing child was found safe.
examples.zh: 当失踪的孩子被确认平安无事时，房间里的人明显都松了一口气。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 tension, relief 或 error，形容情绪极其强烈如触手可及，或事实显而易见，属正式书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palpable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇晃, 赃物, 洼地, 珍贵物, 垂花饰
lemmas.def_en: valuable goods

examples.en: Conference attendees left with bags full of promotional swag, including branded pens and shirts.
examples.zh: 参会者离开时手里提满了装有宣传赠品的袋子，里面有印着品牌标识的钢笔和T恤。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指非法所得的赃物，现代口语中也高频指展会派发的免费礼品或展现出的自信风度（swagger）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反面乌托邦的,反面假想国的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or resembling a dystopia

examples.en: The novel depicts a dystopian future where citizens are constantly monitored by authoritarian algorithms.
examples.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个反乌托邦式的未来，公民时刻受到独裁算法的严密监控。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 future, novel, vision 或 world，指描绘出极端压抑、苦难假想社会的文学题材或场景。

lemmas.def_en: state in which the conditions of life are extremely bad as from deprivation or oppression or terror

examples.en: The novel portrays a grim dystopia where technology monitors every human thought.
examples.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个技术监视人类一切思想的冷酷反乌托邦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dystopian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
lemmas.def_en: a manner of speaking that is natural to native speakers of a language

examples.en: To master a foreign language, one must understand its culture rather than simply memorize each idiom.
examples.zh: 要想精通一门外语，就必须理解其文化，而不仅仅是死记硬背每一个习语。

lemmas.usage_note: 指特定语言中不能望文生义的惯用习语或成语，也可引申指特定流派特有的艺术风格与表现手法。

lemmas.def_zh: 符合语言习惯的, 惯用的, 有许多习语的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or conforming to idiom

examples.en: She speaks fluent French with natural phrasing and idiomatic expressions throughout.
examples.zh: 她法语流利，言语间满是地道自然的习惯表达。

lemmas.def_en: in an idiomatic manner

examples.en: he expressed himself idiomatically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 idiom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 代替, 接替, 有利, 用处, 好处
lemmas.def_en: the post or function properly or customarily occupied or served by another

examples.en: Her extensive experience in crisis management stood her in good stead during the corporate restructuring.
examples.zh: 她在危机管理方面的丰富经验在公司重组期间对她大有裨益。

lemmas.usage_note: 极少单独作主宾语，绝大多数见于固定短语 in one's stead（代替）或 stand sb in good stead（对某人极有用）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 归还, 偿还, 赔偿
lemmas.def_en: a sum of money paid in compensation for loss or injury

examples.en: The judge ordered the convicted fraudster to make full financial restitution to the victims.
examples.zh: 法官命令这名被定罪的诈骗犯向受害者提供全额经济赔偿。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与正式文体中指依法赔偿损失或归还原物，常见搭配 make restitution to sb for sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 restitution 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a secondary or inferior position or status

examples.en: During the initial phase of the product launch, long-term profit goals had to take a backseat to customer acquisition.
examples.zh: 在产品发布的初始阶段，长期利润目标不得不让位于客户获取。

lemmas.usage_note: 除本义指车辆后座外，常用于比喻短语 take a backseat，表示处于次要、从属或不插手的地位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backseat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 需氧的, 需氧菌产生的, 增氧健身法的
lemmas.def_en: depending on free oxygen or air

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise such as jogging strengthens the heart and enhances lung capacity.
examples.zh: 慢跑等规律的有氧运动能够强健心脏并增强肺活量。

lemmas.usage_note: 在生物学中指依赖氧气生存的，日常生活中常修饰 exercise, workout 或 capacity，指有氧锻炼。

lemmas.def_zh: 有氧运动法；增氧健身法
lemmas.def_en: exercise that increases the need for oxygen

examples.en: She attends a weekly aerobics class to improve her overall cardiovascular fitness.
examples.zh: 她每周参加一次有氧健身操课程以改善心血管健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aerobic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全体随行人员, 陪同人员
lemmas.def_en: the group following and attending to some important person

examples.en: The rock star arrived at the premier surrounded by a large entourage of bodyguards and assistants.
examples.zh: 这位摇滚巨星在保镖和助理组成的大批随行人员簇拥下抵达了首映礼现场。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作为集合名词，指跟随政客、明星或重要人物前呼后拥的随行班底或保镖团队，属正式用词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entourage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶名, 臭名, 声名狼藉
lemmas.def_en: the state of being known for some unfavorable act or quality

examples.en: The hacker achieved international notoriety after infiltrating several high-security government databases.
examples.zh: 这名黑客在入侵了几个高度机密的政府数据库后，在国际上声名狼藉。

lemmas.usage_note: 含有强烈的负面色彩，专指因丑闻、罪行或劣迹而出的臭名，常见搭配 gain/achieve notoriety for sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 notoriety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大瀑布, 奔流, 暴雨, 白内障
lemmas.def_en: an eye disease that involves the clouding or opacification of the natural lens of the eye

examples.en: The elderly surgeon successfully removed the cataract to restore the patient's vision.
examples.zh: 这位年长的外科医生成功切除了白内障，使患者恢复了视力。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指医学上的白内障或文学语境中的大瀑布、倾盆大雨，多作可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cataract 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the class Mammalia

examples.en: Researchers are investigating the mammalian brain to understand memory formation.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在探索哺乳动物的大脑以了解记忆的形成过程。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业学术词汇，修饰生物结构、进化或物种特征，常与 tissue、species 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mammalian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱好音乐的, 交响乐团的, 爱乐团体的
lemmas.def_en: composing or characteristic of an orchestral group

examples.en: She was invited to perform as a guest soloist with the philharmonic orchestra.
examples.zh: 她受邀作为客座独奏家与该爱乐乐团同台演出。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于乐团专有名词中，大写首字母，常与 orchestra 或 society 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 philharmonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the most powerful members of a society

examples.en: In the nineteenth century, the local gentry held immense political influence in the county.
examples.zh: 在十九世纪，当地绅士阶层在该县拥有巨大的政治影响力。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，指上流阶层或乡绅阶级，作主语时谓语动词常用复数形式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gentry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward the south

examples.en: Every autumn, large flocks of birds fly southward to escape the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，大群鸟类向南迁飞以躲避严寒的冬季。

lemmas.usage_note: 作副词表示朝南方移动，常修饰 head、travel、migrate 等表位移的动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝南的方向(或地点、地区)
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees

examples.en: The scouts peered into the southward, watching for any sign of approaching dust.
examples.zh: 侦察兵凝望着南方，密切注意着任何逼近的烟尘迹象。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示南方或向南的方向，通常与介词 to 或 toward 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 southward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长期间的, 长期存在的
lemmas.def_en: having existed for a long time

examples.en: The two neighboring countries finally resolved their longstanding border dispute.
examples.zh: 这两个邻国最终解决了长期存在的边界争端。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语修饰 dispute、tradition、friendship 等，强调存在时间久远且稳固。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 longstanding 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to aerodynamics

examples.en: The sports car features an aerodynamic design that enhances both speed and fuel efficiency.
examples.zh: 这款跑车采用流线型空气动力学设计，既提升了速度又提高了燃油效率。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容物体外形具有流线型以减小空气阻力，常修饰 design、shape 或 drag。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of mechanics that deals with the motion of gases (especially air) and their effects on bodies in the flow

examples.en: Engineers improved the car's aerodynamics to reduce drag and increase its fuel efficiency.
examples.zh: 工程师改进了汽车的空气动力学性能，以减少阻力并提高燃油效率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aerodynamic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an extemporaneous speech or remark

examples.en: The pianist delighted the audience by performing a delicate impromptu as an encore.
examples.zh: 钢琴家演奏了一首优美的即兴曲作为返场曲目，令观众赞叹不已。

lemmas.usage_note: 指未经准备的即兴演出或音乐上的即兴曲，为可数名词，常与 play 或 compose 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impromptu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 专业词典, 术语集, 词表
lemmas.def_en: an alphabetical list of technical terms in some specialized field of knowledge; usually published as an appendix to a text on that field

examples.en: Readers can consult the glossary at the back of the book for definitions of technical terms.
examples.zh: 读者可查阅书末的词汇表以获取专业术语的定义。

lemmas.usage_note: 指附在书后或专业文件中的词汇表，常搭配 consult、provide 或 include。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glossary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the organ of sight

examples.en: The ophthalmologist carefully examined the internal structures of the patient's oculus.
examples.zh: 眼科医生仔细检查了患者眼球的内部结构。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业词汇，医学上指眼球或眼睛，建筑学上指圆顶天窗，复数形式为 oculi。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled in testing for defects of vision in order to prescribe corrective glasses

examples.en: After complaining of blurry vision, she scheduled an immediate appointment with her oculist.
examples.zh: 在抱怨视线模糊后，她立刻预约了眼科医生看诊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oculus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to regain consciousness

examples.en: Paramedics worked tirelessly for twenty minutes to resuscitate the drowning victim.
examples.zh: 急救人员不知疲倦地抢救了二十分钟，终于使溺水者苏醒过来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于医学急救或经济、文化等抽象事物的复兴，及物为主，常与patient、economy搭配。

lemmas.def_en: the act of reviving a person and returning them to consciousness

examples.en: although he was apparently drowned, resuscitation was accomplished by artificial respiration

lemmas.def_zh: 使复活的人, 复苏器
lemmas.def_en: a breathing apparatus used for resuscitation by forcing oxygen into the lungs of a person who has undergone asphyxia or arrest of respiration

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resuscitate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄脏, 玷污, 损害
lemmas.def_en: mar or spoil the appearance of

examples.en: A single conviction for misconduct would permanently blemish his otherwise spotless reputation.
examples.zh: 一次不当行为的定罪将永久玷污他原本无可挑剔的名誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以及物动词形式出现，多用于抽象语境，表示损害名誉、记录或完美形象，书面语色彩浓厚。

lemmas.def_zh: 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的, 无污点的, 清白的
lemmas.def_en: free from physical or moral spots or stains

examples.en: an unblemished record
an unblemished complexion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blemish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使减弱, 使纤细；变稀薄, 变纤细, 减少
lemmas.def_en: weaken the consistency of (a chemical substance)

examples.en: The thick concrete walls considerably attenuated the radio signal.
examples.zh: 厚重的混凝土墙大大减弱了无线电信号。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于科学、医学或正式语境，表示削弱力量、影响、信号或病原体毒性，可作及物或不及物动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 变稀薄, 变纤细, 衰减
lemmas.def_en: weakening in force or intensity

examples.en: attenuation in the volume of the sound

lemmas.def_en: an electrical device for attenuating the strength of an electrical signal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attenuate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an easy return of a tennis ball in a high arc

examples.en: Her opponent rushed to the net, but she countered with a delicate lob over his head.
examples.zh: 对手冲上网前，但她顺势打出一记精妙的挑高球越过了对方头顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指网球等球类运动中划出高弧线的吊高球，为可数名词，常与hit、play搭配。

lemmas.def_en: propel in a high arc

examples.en: Protesters lobbed smoke canisters into the empty street to block the police advance.
examples.zh: 抗议者将烟雾罐抛掷到空旷的街道上，以阻挡警方的推进。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指把球挑高，也可引申为向上抛投催泪瓦斯、炸弹等，及物或不及物皆可，常接介词over/into。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: deprive of by deceit

examples.en: He was convicted of conspiracy to defraud investors of millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 他因合谋诈骗投资者数百万美元而被判有罪。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与正式商业用语，固定搭配为defraud sb. of sth.，指通过欺诈手段非法占有钱财。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 defraud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 相称的, 成比例的, 适当的
lemmas.def_en: being in due proportion

examples.en: The punishment inflicted should always be proportionate to the severity of the crime.
examples.zh: 所处刑罚应当始终与罪行的严重程度相适应。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常与介词to搭配（proportionate to），指某事物在规模、程度或重要性上成比例或相称。

lemmas.def_en: to a proportionate degree

examples.en: your salary will rise proportionately to your workload

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proportionate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the person in charge of a post office

examples.en: The village postmaster sorted the mail efficiently before the morning delivery began.
examples.zh: 这位乡村邮政局长在早晨投递开始前高效地将信件分拣完毕。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指当地邮局的主管或局长，在计算机网络语境中也可指负责处理邮件系统错误的管理员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postmaster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fixed number of lines of verse forming a unit of a poem

examples.en: The team dominated the opening stanza of the match, scoring twice within ten minutes.
examples.zh: 该队在比赛第一节占据绝对优势，十分钟内连进两球。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指诗歌的一节；在体育报道中也可借指比赛的某一节或局（如节、半场），为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stanza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the expensive fur of a mink

examples.en: She wrapped herself in a luxurious mink to brave the freezing winter evening.
examples.zh: 她裹上一件奢华的貂皮大衣，以抵御冬夜的刺骨严寒。

lemmas.usage_note: 指动物时为可数名词；指貂皮毛料时为不可数名词；口语中常可数指代一件贵重的貂皮大衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吼叫, 怒骂, 缠结；咆哮着说, 搞乱, 使缠结
lemmas.def_en: utter in an angry, sharp, or abrupt tone

examples.en: An overturned truck snarled traffic across the downtown bridge for three hours.
examples.zh: 一辆翻倒的卡车使市中心大桥上的交通陷入瘫痪长达三小时。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指动物龇牙低吼，人咆哮厉声说话，或比喻交通/毛发陷入混乱纠缠，常接up构成snarl up。

lemmas.def_zh: 要咆哮的, 脾气坏的, 纠缠在一起的
lemmas.def_en: tangled in knots or snarls

examples.en: a mass of knotted string
snarled thread

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snarl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫, 踌躇, 吃惊, 搪塞；搞坏
lemmas.def_en: startle with amazement or fear

examples.en: The sheer scale of the universe can truly boggle the human mind.
examples.zh: 宇宙庞大的规模确实能让人类的大脑感到不可思议。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定短语 boggle the mind 或 the mind boggles，表示某事令人难以置信或困惑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 辛苦的, 勤勉的, 小心的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by extreme care and great effort

examples.en: After months of painstaking research, the historians finally authenticated the manuscript.
examples.zh: 经过数月极其细致艰苦的研究，历史学家们终于证实了这份手稿的真伪。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 research、effort 或 attention，强调耗费巨大心血且极度专注细节，带有褒义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: in a fastidious and painstaking manner

examples.en: it is almost a waste of time painstakingly to learn the routines of selling

family_guide.root_logic: 以 painstaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine concerned with the eye and its diseases

examples.en: She decided to specialize in pediatric ophthalmology during her clinical residency.
examples.zh: 她在住院医师培训期间决定专攻小儿眼科。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业术语，指眼科学，不可数；常与 department of 或 field of 连用，多见于正式医疗文本。

lemmas.def_en: a medical doctor specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the eye

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ophthalmology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装饰物；小机械；未定名的主要新产品
lemmas.def_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known

examples.en: You can add a weather widget to your home screen for quick daily updates.
examples.zh: 你可以在主屏幕上添加一个天气微件，以便快速查看每日更新。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词；经济学中指假想的小商品，现代计算机语境下多指手机或网页上的桌面微件、挂件工具。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 widget 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small lynx of North America

examples.en: Trail cameras captured a solitary bobcat prowling through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 追踪摄像头拍摄到一只独行的短尾猫在密林中潜行。

lemmas.usage_note: 指北美短尾猫，作可数名词；常用于动物学、生态学及野生动物保护相关的语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bobcat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boneless steak cut from the tenderloin of beef

examples.en: The ancient priest wore a simple linen fillet tied around his brow.
examples.zh: 这位古代祭司额头上系着一根简单的亚麻发带。

lemmas.usage_note: 指古代用于束发或装饰的头带、细带子，为可数名词，常见于历史、古典文学或服装史语境。

lemmas.def_en: decorate with a lace of geometric designs

examples.en: Maidens would fillet their flowing hair with ribbons before the festival dance.
examples.zh: 在节日舞蹈开始前，少女们会用丝带将散落的长发束扎起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用带子束缚、系紧或捆扎；属于罕见古典文雅用法，须带名词宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fillet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再讲, 重复, 重说
lemmas.def_en: render verbally,

examples.en: The novel retells the classic Greek myth from the heroine's viewpoint.
examples.zh: 这部小说从女主角的视角重新讲述了这个经典的希腊神话。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指以新方式或角度重新讲述故事、神话，常与 story、tale 或 from the perspective of 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: render verbally,

examples.en: recite a poem
retell a story

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 描绘...的轮廓, 描绘, 描写
lemmas.def_en: show the form or outline of

examples.en: The contract clearly delineates the specific responsibilities of each partner.
examples.zh: 该合同清晰地界定了每位合伙人的具体职责。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于正式公文或学术写作，后接 boundary、responsibilities 或 plan，表示精确勾勒或阐明。

lemmas.def_zh: 画轮廓, 略图, 描述
lemmas.def_en: a graphic or vivid verbal description

examples.en: too often the narrative was interrupted by long word pictures
the author gives a depressing picture of life in Poland

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delineate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 费力的, 努力的, 险峻的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion; especially physical effort

examples.en: Rescue teams embarked on an arduous climb up the steep, snow-covered mountain.
examples.zh: 救援队踏上了一段极其艰险的攀登之旅，向着陡峭积雪的山峰进发。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 journey、task 或 process，强调过程极其艰难曲折、耗费体力与精力，属书面正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: in an arduous manner

examples.en: they worked arduously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arduous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: place under suspicion or cast doubt upon

examples.en: Unfounded allegations must not be allowed to sully the minister's reputation.
examples.zh: 绝不能允许毫无根据的指控玷污部长的声誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于比喻义，及物动词，常接 reputation、name 或 honor，表达“玷污声誉或名节”，语体庄重偏文雅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sully 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 丁香, 丁香花, 淡紫色
lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Syringa having large panicles of usually fragrant flowers

examples.en: The sweet scent of the blooming lilac drifted gently through the open window.
examples.zh: 盛开的丁香散发出的阵阵甜香，轻轻飘进了敞开的窗户。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指丁香花或淡紫色，可与bush、scent搭配，书面语与日常均常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lilac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the clear (and often sudden) understanding of a complex situation

examples.en: She had a sudden brainstorm that solved the complex logistics problem instantly.
examples.zh: 她突然灵机一动，瞬间解决了那个复杂的物流难题。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词指突然的灵感或突发奇想，也可指瞬间糊涂，常与have a搭配。

lemmas.def_en: try to solve a problem by thinking intensely about it

examples.en: The marketing team met yesterday to brainstorm new campaign strategies for the product.
examples.zh: 营销团队昨天开会，为该产品的新推广策略集思广益。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物或不及物动词，指集体献计献策或头脑风暴，常接ideas或solutions。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brainstorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (使)工作过度, 使过分劳累
lemmas.def_en: use too much

examples.en: If you continue to overwork yourself like this, your health will inevitably suffer.
examples.zh: 如果你继续这样过度劳累自己，你的健康迟早会出问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，常与oneself连用表示劳累过度，带消极色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 从事安装的人, 调节器, (警察)眼线
lemmas.def_en: one who sets written material into type

examples.en: The skilled bone setter carefully realigned the patient's fractured arm without surgery.
examples.zh: 那位熟练的正骨师在没有动手术的情况下，细心地将患者骨折的手臂复位。

lemmas.usage_note: 指安置安装者、调节装置或设定者，常构成复合词如trend-setter。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 setter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: noisy quarrel

examples.en: A heated altercation broke out between the two drivers following the minor traffic collision.
examples.zh: 轻微追尾事故发生后，两名司机之间爆发了一场激烈的口角争吵。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指公开激烈的口角或争吵，常与have an或get into搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 altercation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发话筒, 代言人, (电话)送话口
lemmas.def_en: a part that goes over or into the mouth of a person

examples.en: The state-run newspaper is widely regarded as a mouthpiece for the governing party.
examples.zh: 这家官方报纸被普遍视为执政党的发声喉舌。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指乐器咬嘴、电话送话口，引申为代言人或喉舌，常带轻蔑或政治色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mouthpiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 短篇故事, 中篇小说
lemmas.def_en: a short novel

examples.en: He published a critically acclaimed novella exploring the themes of isolation and memory.
examples.zh: 他出版了一部探讨孤独与记忆主题、广受好评的中篇小说。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学专业术语，指介于短篇与长篇之间的中篇小说，可数名词，常与write搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 novella 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Swiss house with a sloping roof and wide eaves or a house built in this style

examples.en: We rented a cozy wooden chalet high in the Alps for our winter ski vacation.
examples.zh: 我们为了冬季滑雪假期，在阿尔卑斯山高处租了一间温馨的木质小屋。

lemmas.usage_note: 指瑞士风格的木质山间木屋或度假小别墅，多用于旅游与建筑语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chalet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of electrical resistance equal to the resistance between two points on a conductor when a potential difference of one volt between them produces a current of one ampere

examples.en: The circuit requires a ten-ohm resistor to ensure the current stays within safe limits.
examples.zh: 该电路需要一个十欧姆的电阻器，以确保电流保持在安全范围内。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学专业术语，指电阻单位“欧姆”，常与数词连用或用于电路描述中。

lemmas.def_zh: 欧姆的, 以欧姆测定的, 电阻性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or measured in ohms

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ohm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of a former political party in the United States that favored a strong centralized federal government

examples.en: As a devoted federalist, he strongly advocated for a unified and central government.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的联邦制拥护者，他强烈主张建立一个统一的中央政府。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治学用词，指支持中央集权与联邦制度的人，常首字母大写指美国联邦党人。

lemmas.def_en: the idea of a federal organization of more or less self-governing units

examples.en: The balance of power between states and the national government defines American federalism.
examples.zh: 州与中央政府之间的权力平衡界定了美国的联邦制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 federalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵掠, 侵略, 攻击
lemmas.def_en: a sudden short attack

examples.en: The tech company made a successful foray into the electric vehicle market.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司成功进军了电动汽车市场。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指短暂突袭或新领域的初次涉足，常见搭配为 make a foray into。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵略, 劫掠, 袭击
lemmas.def_en: steal goods; take as spoils

examples.en: Enemy soldiers forayed into the border village to seize food and supplies.
examples.zh: 敌军突袭了边境村庄以抢夺粮食和补给。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常与 into 连用表示突袭劫掠，或比喻性地涉足全新领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foray 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: maintain or assert

examples.en: Economists postulate that individuals always act to maximize their own utility.
examples.zh: 经济学家假设个人的行为总是在追求自身效用最大化。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与逻辑用语，指假设某事为真作为推理基础，常后接 that 从句。

lemmas.def_en: (logic) a declaration of something self-evident; something that can be assumed as the basis for argument

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of quail; suitable for roasting or broiling if young; otherwise must be braised

examples.en: The hunter spotted a covey of quail hiding in the tall grass.
examples.zh: 猎人发现了一小群藏在高草丛中的鹌鹑。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作可数名词指鸟类鹌鹑，作不可数名词指鹌鹑肉，复数可同形。

lemmas.def_en: draw back, as with fear or pain

examples.en: Even the bravest warriors quailed before the terrifying sight of the dragon.
examples.zh: 面对恶龙可怕的景象，即使是最勇敢的战士也退缩了。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与 at 或 before 连用，表示在危险或困难面前畏缩怯懦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization

examples.en: The chairperson called the committee meeting to order promptly at nine.
examples.zh: 主席在九点准时宣布委员会会议开始。

lemmas.usage_note: 性别中立词汇，常用于正式会议、委员会或公司董事会中指代主持人员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chairperson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鹊, 珍种家鸽, 饶舌的人
lemmas.def_en: long-tailed black-and-white crow that utters a raucous chattering call

examples.en: She is such a magpie, filling her attic with old trinkets and vintage clothes.
examples.zh: 她真是个爱收集杂物的人，阁楼里塞满了旧饰品和复古服装。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为喜鹊，引申指爱收藏杂物或极其健谈的人，常作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magpie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斑点, 有斑点的东西, 污点, 缺点, 微粒, 肥肉
lemmas.def_en: a very small spot

examples.en: There was not a single speck of dust on the polished mahogany table.
examples.zh: 抛光的红木桌面上连一粒灰尘都没有。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指微小的污点、尘埃或极少量的东西，常见搭配 a speck of dust。

lemmas.def_en: produce specks in or on

examples.en: Freckles specked her cheeks after spending a whole afternoon in the sun.
examples.zh: 在阳光下待了一整个下午后，她的脸颊上布满了雀斑。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于被动语态或过去分词作定语，表示“使布满细小斑点”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: give suck to

examples.en: Female mammals generally begin to lactate shortly after giving birth.
examples.zh: 雌性哺乳动物通常在分娩后不久开始分泌乳汁。

lemmas.usage_note: 生理医学用语，不及物动词，专门描述哺乳动物母体产奶或分泌乳汁。

lemmas.def_zh: 分泌乳汁, 授乳, 哺乳
lemmas.def_en: the period following birth during which milk is secreted

examples.en: lactation normally continues until weaning

lemmas.def_en: producing or secreting milk
lemmas.usage_note: 生物学和医学常用词，常修饰女性或雌性哺乳动物，如 lactating mothers / cows。

examples.en: Nutritional requirements are significantly higher for lactating mothers.
examples.zh: 哺乳期母亲的营养需求显著提高。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lactate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾风, 飓风, 慌张
lemmas.def_en: a rapid active commotion

examples.en: The announcement triggered a flurry of phone calls from anxious investors.
examples.zh: 该公告引发了焦虑的投资者们一连串密集的电话。

lemmas.usage_note: 指阵雪、骤风或突发的一阵忙乱，常见短语 a flurry of activity。

lemmas.def_zh: 使恐慌, 使激动；慌张
lemmas.def_en: move in an agitated or confused manner

examples.en: The unexpected questions flurried the young spokesperson during the interview.
examples.zh: 采访中意料之外的提问让这位年轻的发言人慌了手脚。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作及物动词，常用被动语态，表示使人慌乱或不知所措；罕指下阵雪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flurry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉特(拉脱维亚货币单位)
lemmas.def_en: a broad flat muscle on either side of the back

examples.en: Before adopting the euro in 2014, Latvia's official currency was the lat.
examples.zh: 在2014年采用欧元之前，拉脱维亚的官方货币是拉特。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性货币单位（复数常作 lati），现已随拉脱维亚加入欧元区退出流通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼噜呼噜叫, 发出喉音
lemmas.def_en: make a soft swishing sound

examples.en: The kitten curled up on my lap and began to purr contentedly.
examples.zh: 小猫蜷缩在我的膝盖上，心满意足地打起呼噜来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指猫惬意地发出呼噜声，亦可比喻引擎平稳运转或人娇柔低语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purr 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一个, 独生子, 独身
lemmas.def_en: a single object (as distinguished from a pair)

examples.en: As a confirmed singleton, she thoroughly enjoyed the freedom of living alone in the city.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的单身主义者，她非常享受在城市里独自生活的自由。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于指单身人士、独生子女或数学与编程中的单元素集合，语体正式且多用于客观描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 singleton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 为某人之生父, 招致, 产生, 引起
lemmas.def_en: make children

examples.en: History has shown that prolonged violence only tends to beget further violence.
examples.zh: 历史表明，旷日持久的暴力往往只会招致更多的暴力。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面典雅词，过去式为begot或begat，多引申表示“导致、引起某结果”，常用于正式政论或哲理格言。

lemmas.def_en: make children

examples.en: Abraham begot Isaac
Men often father children but don't recognize them

lemmas.def_en: make children

examples.en: Abraham begot Isaac
Men often father children but don't recognize them

lemmas.def_zh: 私生子的, 靠非法手段获得的
lemmas.def_en: born out of wedlock; - E.A.Freeman

examples.en: the dominions of both rulers passed away to their spurious or doubtful offspring

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beget 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: place (flax, hemp, or jute) in liquid so as to promote loosening of the fibers from the woody tissue

examples.en: Farmers used to ret the harvested flax in natural ponds to soften the fibers.
examples.zh: 农民过去常把收割后的亚麻浸泡在天然池塘中沤软，以使纤维软化。

lemmas.usage_note: 纺织与农业专业术语，指通过水浸等微生物作用使麻类纤维与木质部分离的“沤麻”过程，多作及物动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ret 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣服, 哑弹, 无用物
lemmas.def_en: someone who is unsuccessful

examples.en: The firework failed to ignite properly and turned out to be a complete dud.
examples.zh: 那个烟花未能正常点燃，结果是个彻底的哑弹。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式用语，指哑弹、不中用的失败者或假冒伪劣物，常与动词turn out to be搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 十字架形, 关键, 难题
lemmas.def_en: a small conspicuous constellation in the southern hemisphere in the Milky Way near Centaurus

examples.en: Identifying the root cause of the system failure is the crux of the whole investigation.
examples.zh: 查明系统崩溃的根本原因正是整项调查的关键所在。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与the连用，高频搭配the crux of the matter/problem，用于指出事情的关键所在或核心症结。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cubes of meat marinated and cooked on a skewer usually with vegetables

examples.en: We grilled several skewered lamb kebabs over charcoal during our weekend camping trip.
examples.zh: 在周末野营时，我们在炭火上烤了几串羊肉串。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指将肉类或蔬菜穿成串烤制的菜肴，日常口语常用搭配shish kebab或doner kebab。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kebab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 适于居住的, 可居住的
lemmas.def_en: fit for habitation

examples.en: Astronomers are searching for habitable exoplanets that might possess liquid water on their surfaces.
examples.zh: 天文学家正在搜寻表面可能存在液态水的宜居系外行星。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语或表语，高频搭配habitable zone（宜居带）或render...habitable，指适合居住的条件。

lemmas.def_zh: 可居住性, 适于居住
lemmas.def_en: suitability for living in or on

family_guide.root_logic: 以 habitable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an atmosphere in which visibility is reduced because of a cloud of some substance

examples.en: The lighthouse beam could barely penetrate the dense murk that enveloped the harbor.
examples.zh: 灯塔发出的光束几乎无法穿透笼罩着港口的浓密阴霾。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与the连用作不可数名词，形容浓雾、烟尘或水下等幽暗阴沉的视线环境，具有较强的文学色彩。

lemmas.def_en: an atmosphere in which visibility is reduced because of a cloud of some substance

lemmas.def_zh: 黝暗的, 阴沉的, 朦胧的
lemmas.def_en: (of liquids) clouded as with sediment

examples.en: a cloudy liquid
muddy coffee

family_guide.root_logic: 以 murk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 议会法规专家, 国会议员, 熟悉议会法规而又有经验的议员
lemmas.def_en: an elected member of the British Parliament: a member of the House of Commons

examples.en: Known as a skilled parliamentarian, the senator masterfully used procedural rules to delay the bill.
examples.zh: 作为一位精通议事规则的议员，这位参议员娴熟地运用程序规则推迟了法案表决。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治正式术语，既可指国会议员，亦特指精通议事规则的行家，常用于赞誉其立法辩论才能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parliamentarian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爪, 如爪的手, 魔爪, 爪饰
lemmas.def_en: a sharp hooked claw especially on a bird of prey

examples.en: The eagle swooped down rapidly and seized the trout firmly in its razor-sharp talons.
examples.zh: 那只老鹰迅猛俯冲，用它锋利如刀的爪子牢牢抓住了那条鳟鱼。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指猛禽（如鹰、隼等）锋利的爪，常作复数talons使用，也可用于文学比喻中表示掌控或魔爪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 talon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 招手示意, 召唤, 吸引
lemmas.def_en: signal with the hands or nod

examples.en: She beckoned to the waiter to bring the bill.
examples.zh: 她向服务员招手示意结账。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，接介词 to 表示向某人招手，亦常引申为诱人前景或机会的召唤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beckon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of tapping a telephone or telegraph line to get information

examples.en: Police obtained a warrant to place a wiretap on the suspect's phone.
examples.zh: 警方获得了对嫌疑人电话进行窃听的搜查令。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指电话窃听装置或监听行为，常与 illegal、warrant 或 install 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: tap a telephone or telegraph wire to get information

examples.en: Intelligence agents were suspected of wiretapping foreign diplomats.
examples.zh: 情报人员涉嫌窃听外国外交官的电话。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指私自搭线或依法监听电话通话，宾语多为电话线路或被监控的人员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wiretap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏组织, 使混乱, 瓦解
lemmas.def_en: remove the organization from

examples.en: The sudden blizzard disorganized the city's entire public transit system.
examples.zh: 突如其来的暴风雪彻底打乱了全城的公共交通系统。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态，强调打乱原有秩序、结构或计划，多出现于正式语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 组织的破坏, 解体, 瓦解
lemmas.def_en: a condition in which an orderly system has been disrupted

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 混乱的；无条理的；缺乏组织的
lemmas.def_en: not properly planned and organized; lacking order or a methodical arrangement
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指事物杂乱无章，也可形容人做事没有条理，如 a disorganized desk / person。

examples.en: The meeting was so disorganized that nothing was achieved.
examples.zh: 这次会议组织得一团糟，什么成果也没达成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disorganize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the heat in the interior of the earth

examples.en: Iceland relies heavily on geothermal energy to heat residential buildings.
examples.zh: 冰岛主要依靠地热能为居民住宅供暖。

lemmas.usage_note: 前置形容词，用于科技与环保语境，固定搭配 geothermal energy（地热能）或 power plant。

lemmas.def_en: by means of heat from the interior of the earth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geothermal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cordial disposition

examples.en: The two neighboring countries signed a pact to promote peace and amity.
examples.zh: 两国签署了条约，以促进和平与睦邻友好。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数正式名词，特指国家、团体间的睦邻友好或亲善关系，常与 treaty of amity 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼可亲, 友善, 亲切
lemmas.def_en: a cheerful and agreeable mood

lemmas.def_zh: 亲切的, 和蔼可亲的
lemmas.def_en: disposed to please; - Hal Hinson

examples.en: an amiable villain with a cocky sidelong grin

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the proprietor of a bookstore

examples.en: The independent bookseller survived by hosting frequent author events.
examples.zh: 这家独立书商靠经常举办作家活动得以生存。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既可指经营书籍买卖的个人，也可指书商公司，常搭配 independent bookseller。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookseller 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a crime less serious than a felony

examples.en: Parking in a loading zone is considered a minor traffic infraction.
examples.zh: 在装卸货区域停车被视为轻微的违章行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，法律及正式语境中指对规则、法律或协议的轻微违犯，常搭配 minor infraction。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infraction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 龙头, 开关, 旋塞
lemmas.def_en: a regulator for controlling the flow of a liquid from a reservoir

examples.en: The steady dripping of the leaky bathroom faucet kept him awake.
examples.zh: 浴室水龙头漏水那持续不断的滴答声让他难以入眠。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美英语常用可数名词（英式多用 tap），常搭配 turn on/off the faucet 或 leaky faucet。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faucet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small outdoor fire for warmth or cooking (as at a camp)

examples.en: They gathered around the campfire to roast marshmallows and share ghost stories.
examples.zh: 他们围坐在营火旁烤棉花糖、讲鬼故事。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指露营时的篝火或围火聚会，常搭配 light/build a campfire 或 sit around the campfire。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 campfire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三击未中出局, 失败
lemmas.def_en: an out resulting from the batter getting three strikes

examples.en: His first attempt to secure venture capital was a complete strikeout.
examples.zh: 他为争取风险投资所做的首次尝试彻底落空了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，源于棒球中的“三振出局”，在日常美语中常引申为努力后的彻底失败或未获回应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 strikeout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 机会主义者, 投机取巧者
lemmas.def_en: a person who places expediency above principle

examples.en: A political opportunist will quickly change loyalties to secure a better position.
examples.zh: 投机取巧的政客会迅速转变立场以谋取更高的职位。

lemmas.def_en: taking advantage of opportunities without regard for the consequences for others

examples.en: The politician was accused of pure opportunism after switching parties right before the election.
examples.zh: 这位政客在大选前临阵倒戈，被指责为纯粹的机会主义行径。

lemmas.usage_note: 常含贬义，指缺乏原则、见风使舵的行为；常与 political, pure 连用，多作不可数名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 机会主义的, 投机取巧的
lemmas.def_en: taking immediate advantage, often unethically, of any circumstance of possible benefit
taking immediate advantage, often unethically, of any circumstance of possible benefit

examples.en: A political opportunist will quickly change loyalties to secure a better position.
examples.zh: 投机取巧的政客会迅速转变立场以谋取更高的职位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 opportunism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 报复, 报仇, 报复性劫掠
lemmas.def_en: a retaliatory action against an enemy in wartime

examples.en: The airstrikes were launched in reprisal for the border attack carried out earlier that week.
examples.zh: 空袭是为了报复本周早些时候发生的边境袭击而发动的。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于政治或军事语境，指遭受袭击后的报复行动；常用于 in reprisal for 或 fear of reprisals。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reprisal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small room in which a monk or nun lives

examples.en: She decorated her office cubicle with family photos and small potted plants to make it cozy.
examples.zh: 她在办公室的隔间里装饰了家人照片和小盆栽，让它显得温馨舒适。

lemmas.usage_note: 指办公室的格子间或公共浴室、更衣室的分隔小间；常搭配 office cubicle 或 shower cubicle。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cubicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇篮曲, 催眠曲, 轻柔的音乐
lemmas.def_en: a quiet song intended to lull a child to sleep

examples.en: The mother gently sang a traditional lullaby until her baby finally drifted off to sleep.
examples.zh: 母亲轻声唱着传统的摇篮曲，直到宝宝终于沉沉入睡。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指哄睡用的摇篮曲，也可比喻轻柔催眠的声音；常用动词搭配 sing a lullaby。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lullaby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: compare critically; of texts

examples.en: The research team spent weeks collating data from various international surveys.
examples.zh: 研究团队花了数周时间核对并整理来自各项国际调查的数据。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词，指核对、整理不同来源的数据、文献或纸张；常与 data, information, results 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 核对, 小吃, 斋日的点心, 茶点, 零食, (牧师职位的)委任
lemmas.def_en: a light informal meal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 collate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电烫的头发, 卷发, 化学烫的头发
lemmas.def_en: a city in the European part of Russia

examples.en: She decided to get a perm to add more volume and texture to her flat hair.
examples.zh: 她决定去烫个头发，好让她扁塌的头发显得更蓬松有层次。

lemmas.usage_note: 指通过化学或加热手段烫成的卷发；常见搭配有 have a perm 或 get a tight perm。

lemmas.def_en: give a permanent wave to

examples.en: The stylist washed her hair carefully before proceeding to perm it into loose waves.
examples.zh: 发型师仔细清洗了她的头发，然后将它烫成蓬松的大卷。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词，表示为某人或自己的头发进行化学烫发；常用于 perm one's hair 或以被动语态呈现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Old Testament) a giant Philistine warrior who was slain by David with a slingshot

examples.en: The small startup took on an industry goliath and surprisingly managed to win a huge market share.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司勇敢挑战了行业巨头，出人意料地赢得了巨大的市场份额。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为圣经中的巨人，现常喻指体量庞大且难以撼动的行业巨头；常与 David 相对构成对比。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goliath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a badge worn to show official position

examples.en: The officer proudly wore the gold insignia on his uniform to signify his newly earned rank.
examples.zh: 军官自豪地在制服上佩戴着金色徽章，以展示他刚获得的新军衔。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作复数或集合名词，指军衔、团体或权力的徽章、标志；常搭配 military insignia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insignia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用圆凿削, 挖出, 欺骗
lemmas.def_en: force with the thumb

examples.en: Local vendors were heavily fined for trying to price-gouge customers during the severe snowstorm.
examples.zh: 当地小贩因在暴风雪期间企图恶意哄抬物价敲竹杠，被处以高额罚款。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指用工具或手指挖凿、挖出（常接 out）；口语中还常指敲竹杠、索取漫天要价（gouge prices）。

lemmas.def_zh: <爱尔兰>小流氓; 掠夺式采矿者
lemmas.def_en: an attacker who gouges out the antagonist's eye

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gouge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使怀孕, 使肥沃, 使充满, 灌输
lemmas.def_en: fill, as with a certain quality

examples.en: The fabric was specially treated and impregnated with a water-resistant resin.
examples.zh: 这种织物经过特殊工艺处理，并浸透了防水树脂。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学/生物学指使受孕；工业或化学中常指使充满、渗透，常与介词 with 搭配（impregnate with）。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满, 受精, 注入
lemmas.def_en: material with which something is impregnated

examples.en: the impregnation, whatever it was, had turned the rock blue

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impregnate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: draw from specific cases for more general cases

examples.en: Researchers tried to extrapolate future climate trends from the historical weather data.
examples.zh: 研究人员试图根据历史气象数据推断未来的气候趋势。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于学术或数据分析语境，常见搭配 extrapolate from（从……推断出）或 extrapolate to（外推至）。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics) calculation of the value of a function outside the range of known values

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extrapolate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发布, 公布, 发表, 传播
lemmas.def_en: state or announce

examples.en: The governing council is expected to promulgate the new trade regulations next month.
examples.zh: 管理委员会预计将于下个月正式颁布新的贸易法规。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律或政治用语，常指官方正式颁布法令、法规，或公开宣扬某种理念或学说。

lemmas.def_zh: 发布, 公布, 传播
lemmas.def_en: a public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen

examples.en: the announcement appeared in the local newspaper
the promulgation was written in English

family_guide.root_logic: 以 promulgate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能理解的, 费解的, 无限的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being explained or accounted for

examples.en: The complex mathematical jargon was almost incomprehensible to the general public.
examples.zh: 这些复杂的数学行话对大众而言几乎无法理解。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示难以理解或令人费解的，常与介词 to 连用（incomprehensible to sb），修饰语言、行为或动机。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可理解, 不可思议
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being incomprehensible

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incomprehensible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 压制, 平息, 减轻
lemmas.def_en: suppress or crush completely

examples.en: Extra police forces were deployed to the city center to quell the growing unrest.
examples.zh: 额外的警力被部署到市中心以平息日益蔓延的骚乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语，常与 rebellion, protest 等搭配表示武力平息叛乱，或与 fears, doubts 搭配表示消除负面情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the commonest type of solidified lava; a dense dark grey fine-grained igneous rock that is composed chiefly of plagioclase feldspar and pyroxene

examples.en: The island's rugged coastline is mostly formed from hardened volcanic basalt.
examples.zh: 该岛崎岖的海岸线主要由硬化的火山玄武岩构成。

lemmas.usage_note: 地质学专业名词，指玄武岩，不可数名词，常与 column（柱状节理）、formation（岩层）连用。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing basalt

examples.en: basaltic magma is fluid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 basalt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地球外的, 地球大气圈外的
lemmas.def_en: originating or located or occurring outside Earth or its atmosphere

examples.en: Astronomers are scanning radio frequencies for any signs of extraterrestrial life.
examples.zh: 天文学家正在扫描无线电频率，以寻找外星生命的迹象。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 life, intelligence, origin，指地球之外的、天外的，多见于科幻或天文语境。

lemmas.def_en: a form of life assumed to exist outside the Earth or its atmosphere

examples.en: The sci-fi novel depicts a peaceful encounter between humans and a friendly extraterrestrial.
examples.zh: 这部科幻小说描绘了人类与一位友善的外星人之间的和平相遇。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指外星人或外星生物，常用简写 ET 代替，多见于大众文化和科幻作品中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extraterrestrial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷熟练的, 灵巧的
lemmas.def_en: skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands

examples.en: With a few deft strokes of the brush, the artist captured the subject's expression perfectly.
examples.zh: 画家仅用了几下敏捷灵巧的笔触，就完美捕捉到了模特的表情。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可形容动作熟练灵巧（deft hands/fingers），也可形容处理问题手段圆融巧妙（deft handling）。

lemmas.def_en: with dexterity; in a dexterous manner

examples.en: dextrously he untied the knots

lemmas.def_en: skillful performance or ability without difficulty

examples.en: his quick adeptness was a product of good design
he was famous for his facility as an archer

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 西塞罗（古罗马政治家、雄辩家、著作家）；西塞罗（美国伊利诺伊州东北部城市, 在芝加哥附近）
lemmas.def_en: a linear unit of the size of type slightly larger than an em

examples.en: The philosophy professor quoted extensively from Cicero to illustrate classic rhetorical techniques.
examples.zh: 哲学教授大量引用西塞罗的言论来阐明经典的修辞技巧。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词，常指古罗马雄辩家西塞罗；亦可作印刷计量单位（西塞罗，约合4.5毫米）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cicero 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 权宜的, 临时代用的
lemmas.def_en: done or made using whatever is available

examples.en: Volunteers set up a makeshift clinic in the school gymnasium to treat injured survivors.
examples.zh: 志愿者在学校体育馆设立了一个临时诊所来救治受伤的幸存者。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语，修饰 hospital, shelter, solution 等，表示资源匮乏时的临时替代方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 makeshift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 策略, 手段, (桥牌中的)飞牌
lemmas.def_en: subtly skillful handling of a situation

examples.en: The diplomat handled the delicate negotiations with remarkable tact and finesse.
examples.zh: 这位外交官以非凡的机智与圆熟的手腕处理了这次棘手的谈判。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调处理复杂局面时的高超技巧与手腕；常见搭配 with great finesse。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 finesse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 收税栅, 收税路, 收税高速公路, 公路, 大道
lemmas.def_en: (from 16th to 19th centuries) gates set across a road to prevent passage until a toll had been paid

examples.en: Drivers must pay a toll before entering the state turnpike.
examples.zh: 司机进入该州收费高速公路前必须缴纳通行费。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指美国的收费高速公路，多用于正式交通规划或日常驾车指引，常见于路名中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turnpike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 要点, 要旨, 依据
lemmas.def_en: the central meaning or theme of a speech or literary work

examples.en: I couldn't follow every detail, but I got the gist of his argument.
examples.zh: 我没能跟上每一个细节，但我明白了他论点的要旨。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与定冠词 the 连用，多搭配 get/catch the gist of 或 give the gist，用于日常与职场口笔语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超越国界的, 跨国的
