lemmas.def_en: involving or operating in several nations or nationalities

examples.en: Combating transnational crime requires seamless cooperation between international police forces.
examples.zh: 打击跨国犯罪需要国际警力之间的紧密合作。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于政治、经济学等学术及正式语境，常修饰 corporation、crime 或 cooperation。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transnational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: output relative to input; the amount passing through a system from input to output (especially of a computer program over a period of time)

examples.en: Upgrading the network hardware significantly increased data throughput.
examples.zh: 升级网络硬件显著提高了数据吞吐量。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于计算机、工业工程及供应链管理，指单位时间内的处理量或流通量，多为不可数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 throughput 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受惩罚, 无事, 无患
lemmas.def_en: exemption from punishment or loss

examples.en: Corrupt officials acted with complete impunity for decades before the investigation began.
examples.zh: 在调查开始之前的几十年里，腐败官员们一直完全逍遥法外。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于正式书面语及法律语境，高频搭配 with impunity，意为“肆无忌惮地、逍遥法外”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impunity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金银, 金银块, 纯金
lemmas.def_en: a mass of precious metal

examples.en: The central bank stores tons of gold bullion in high-security underground vaults.
examples.zh: 中央银行在高安全级别的地下金库中存放了数吨金条。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作不可数名词，指金银等大块贵金属，常与 gold 或 silver 连用，多见于金融储备语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large west African tree having large palmately lobed leaves and axillary cymose panicles of small white flowers and one-winged seeds; yields soft white to pale yellow wood

examples.en: The lively rhythm of the samba energized the entire carnival crowd.
examples.zh: 桑巴舞欢快的节奏激发了整个狂欢节人群的热情。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指巴西桑巴舞曲或舞蹈，常与 dance 或 rhythm 连用，也可特指一段具体的桑巴舞曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 samba 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a multiple star with 6 components; second brightest in Gemini; close to Pollux

examples.en: She sprinkled a fine layer of sugar from the castor onto the freshly baked tart.
examples.zh: 她用调味瓶把一层薄薄的糖粉撒在刚烤好的馅饼上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指多孔调味瓶（如胡椒罐）或海狸及其皮毛，常见于 castor sugar（细砂糖）等固定搭配中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 castor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 信息的, 情报的, 提供消息的, 介绍情况的, 提供情报的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the nature of information

examples.en: The clinic distributed an informational pamphlet explaining the vaccination process.
examples.zh: 诊所分发了一份介绍疫苗接种流程的信息手册。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于正式说明或商务场景，强调提供事实性资讯，常修饰 brochure、interview 或 website。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 informational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a (temporary) relief from harm or discomfort

examples.en: The weekend offered a brief respite from the relentless pressure of work.
examples.zh: 周末让人从无休止的工作压力中得到短暂的喘息。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式文体，表示短暂的喘息或延期，常与介词 from 搭配构成 respite from...

family_guide.root_logic: 以 respite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: English linguist who contributed to linguistic semantics and to prosodic phonology and who was noted for his insistence on studying both sound and meaning in context (1890-1960)

examples.en: A cold mist slowly rolled over the waters of the firth at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，一层冷雾慢慢笼罩了狭长海湾的水面。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理名词，常特指苏格兰地区的狭长海湾或河口，多与专有名词连用，书面语色彩浓厚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young unmarried woman who lives alone

examples.en: Her friends threw an unforgettable bachelorette party the weekend before the wedding.
examples.zh: 她的朋友们在婚礼前的周末为她举办了一场难忘的单身女郎派对。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于美式英语口语与社交场合，常构成固定搭配 bachelorette party（单身女郎派对）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bachelorette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出生, 出生的情况, 诞生, 出生地, 耶酥诞生
lemmas.def_en: the event of being born

examples.en: The school children staged a traditional nativity play just before the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假前，小学生们上演了一出传统的耶稣诞生剧。

lemmas.usage_note: 常大写指“耶稣降生”，常见搭配有 Nativity play（耶稣诞生剧）或 Nativity scene（圣景模型）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nativity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 安德洛墨达(希腊神话中埃塞俄比亚的公主), 仙女座
lemmas.def_en: broad-leaved evergreen Asiatic shrub with glossy leaves and drooping clusters of white flowers

examples.en: Astronomers captured a sharper image of the distant Andromeda galaxy using the new telescope.
examples.zh: 天文学家利用新望远镜拍摄到了遥远仙女座星系更为清晰的图像。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词，常大写用于天文学指仙女座（Andromeda Galaxy）或古希腊神话人物，属学术或神话语域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 andromeda 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (New Testament) day at the end of time following Armageddon when God will decree the fates of all individual humans according to the good and evil of their earthly lives

examples.en: Environmental scientists warned against ignoring the risks of a climate doomsday.
examples.zh: 环境科学家警告称，绝不能忽视气候灾难末日的风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于比喻毁灭性的灾难日，常与 scenario（设想）、clock（末日之钟）搭配，语气体量沉重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doomsday 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用作感化的, 应处监禁的, 教养所的, 收容所的
lemmas.def_en: used for punishment or reform of criminals or wrongdoers

examples.en: The state legislature proposed several penitentiary reforms to improve inmate rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 州立法机构提出了几项感化监禁制度改革方案，以改善囚犯的改造工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与司法语境正式用词，修饰与监禁、感化院或刑事惩处相关的制度或措施，作定语居多。

lemmas.def_zh: 忏悔的, 悔悟的, 表示悔罪的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or expressing remorse for misdeeds

examples.en: The penitent thief returned the stolen money and apologized to the owner.
examples.zh: 悔过的窃贼归还了偷来的钱，并向失主道了歉。

lemmas.def_zh: 忏悔的, 赎罪的, 苦修的, 作为补赎的
lemmas.def_en: showing or constituting penance

examples.en: penitential tears
wrote a penitential letter apologizing for her hasty words

lemmas.def_en: showing remorse

lemmas.def_zh: 后悔, 忏悔, 改过
lemmas.def_en: remorse for your past conduct

examples.en: He bowed his head in sincere penitence after realizing the pain he caused.
examples.zh: 在意识到自己造成的伤害后，他怀着由衷的悔意低下了头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 penitentiary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the young of a herring or sprat or similar fish

examples.en: Flocks of seabirds plunged into the water to feed on the abundant britt near the surface.
examples.zh: 成群的海鸟扎入水中，捕食靠近水面的大量小鲱鱼。

lemmas.usage_note: 渔业与海洋生物学术语，指鲱鱼等鱼类的幼苗或小鱼群，多用作不可数或集体名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 britt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (使)显得新鲜, (使)精神饱满, (使)减少咸味
lemmas.def_en: make (to feel) fresh

examples.en: She went to the restroom to freshen up before the evening banquet began.
examples.zh: 晚宴开始前，她去洗手间梳洗整理了一番。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 up 连用表示“梳洗、翻新、添饮”；用于天气时作不及物动词指风力增强，多用于日常或描写。

lemmas.def_en: anything that freshens

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freshen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 压缩, 束紧, 使收缩；收缩
lemmas.def_en: squeeze or press together

examples.en: Cold temperatures cause the blood vessels to constrict rapidly.
examples.zh: 寒冷的气温会导致血管迅速收缩。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，既指生理上的血管、肌肉收缩，也可比喻限制自由或经济发展。

lemmas.def_zh: 压缩, 收缩, 紧压的感觉
lemmas.def_en: a narrowing that reduces the flow through a channel

lemmas.def_zh: 使压缩的东西, 缩肌, 大蟒
lemmas.def_en: any of various large nonvenomous snakes that kill their prey by crushing it in its coils

family_guide.root_logic: 以 constrict 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tube running from the liquid in a vessel to a lower level outside the vessel so that atmospheric pressure forces the liquid through the tube

examples.en: He used a plastic siphon to transfer gasoline safely between the containers.
examples.zh: 他用一根塑料虹吸管在容器间安全地抽取汽油。

lemmas.usage_note: 指物理上的虹吸管或生物解剖中的虹吸器官，常搭配 use a siphon 或 a siphon tube。

lemmas.def_zh: 用虹吸管吸出, 抽取；通过虹吸管
lemmas.def_en: convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon

examples.en: The corrupt executive managed to siphon off company funds into his personal offshore account.
examples.zh: 那名腐败的高管设法将公司资金暗中转移到了自己的个人离岸账户中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 off 或 away 搭配，既指物理上虹吸抽液，也大量用于商业、政治语境比喻非法转移资金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siphon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无尾礼服, 男小礼服
lemmas.def_en: semiformal evening dress for men

examples.en: He rented a classic black tuxedo for his sister's formal evening wedding.
examples.zh: 他为姐姐的正式晚间婚礼租了一套经典的黑色无尾礼服。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指男士在正式晚宴或庆典穿着的半正式晚礼服，常与 rent、wear、black-tie 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tuxedo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: electro-acoustic transducer that converts electrical signals into sounds loud enough to be heard at a distance

examples.en: An urgent announcement blared through the station loudspeaker, warning passengers of the delay.
examples.zh: 车站扩音器里传出一则紧急通知，提醒乘客列车晚点。

lemmas.usage_note: 指扬声器或扩音装置，常与 over/through the loudspeaker 或 blare 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loudspeaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反驳, 回嘴, 反击；反击, 反驳, 蒸馏
lemmas.def_en: answer back

examples.en: "I can manage on my own," she retorted sharply before slamming the door.
examples.zh: “我自己能应付，”她在摔门前反唇相讥道。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示敏捷、尖锐或愤怒地反驳回嘴，常接 that 从句，或与 angrily、sharply 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使机械化, 用机械装置, 机动化
lemmas.def_en: equip with armed and armored motor vehicles

examples.en: The government launched a project to mechanize traditional farming methods across the region.
examples.zh: 政府发起了一项在该地区推行传统农业耕作机械化的项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用机械取代人力或使军队机动化，常与 agriculture、operations 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of having a highly technical implementation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mechanize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 林务员, 森林动物, 森林居民, 森林管理人
lemmas.def_en: English writer of adventure novels featuring Captain Horatio Hornblower (1899-1966)

examples.en: The local forester regularly inspects the timberland to prevent illegal logging and disease.
examples.zh: 当地林务员定期视察林地，以防止非法采伐和树木病害。

lemmas.usage_note: 指负责森林培育、维护与管理的林务官或护林员，多用于生态保护和林业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forester 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杏子, 杏树, 杏黄色
lemmas.def_en: Asian tree having clusters of usually white blossoms and edible fruit resembling the peach

examples.en: She added a generous spoonful of dried apricots and nuts to her morning oatmeal.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的燕麦粥里加了满满一勺杏干和坚果。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指杏树、杏果（可数）或杏黄色（不可数），常与 jam、tree 或 dried 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apricot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clever remark

examples.en: His witty mot drew appreciative laughter from everyone at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 他机智风趣的警句引得餐桌上的所有人发出赞许的笑声。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语借词，指机智巧妙的警句妙语，最常出现在固定搭配 bon mot 中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然说出, 射出；射出, 射精
lemmas.def_en: utter impulsively

examples.en: "What a marvelous discovery!" the professor ejaculated in excitement.
examples.zh: “多惊人的发现啊！”教授兴奋地脱口叫道。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学语境中指脱口而出，生理医学语境中指射精或喷出液体，可作及物或不及物动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然说出, 射出, 射精
lemmas.def_en: an abrupt emphatic exclamation expressing emotion

lemmas.def_zh: 突然叫喊的人, 射出者
lemmas.def_en: a man who ejaculates semen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ejaculate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尊敬, 崇敬, 崇拜
lemmas.def_en: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of

examples.en: Many cultures deeply venerate their ancestors through annual ceremonial rituals.
examples.zh: 许多文化都会通过一年一度的仪式盛典来深深崇敬他们的祖先。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指怀着敬畏之心崇敬长者、圣人或传统，常与 as 或 for 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 尊敬, 崇敬, 崇拜
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of profound respect for someone or something

examples.en: the fear of God
the Chinese reverence for the dead

family_guide.root_logic: 以 venerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浣熊, 狡滑的人, 黑人
lemmas.def_en: an eccentric or undignified rustic

examples.en: We installed a secure latch on the garbage bin to keep the coons out at night.
examples.zh: 我们在垃圾桶上装了牢固的锁闩，以防浣熊夜间翻找。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中可指浣熊（raccoon 的简称）；作人称指称时为极具侮辱性的种族歧视禁忌词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 哨兵线, 非常警戒线, 饰带
lemmas.def_en: a series of sentinels or of military posts enclosing or guarding some place or thing

examples.en: Police formed a tight cordon around the embassy to keep protesters away.
examples.zh: 警方在使馆周围拉起了严密的警戒线，以阻拦抗议者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于新闻与警务语境，常与 police 或 sanitary 连用，构成 cordon of 搭配表示封锁线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cordon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reduce in worth or character, usually verbally

examples.en: I wouldn't demean myself by asking him for financial help.
examples.zh: 我绝不会自贬身价向他寻求经济援助。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 oneself 连用构成反身动词短语，表示“自贬身价”，常用于正式书面或道德批评语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ditch dug as a fortification and usually filled with water

examples.en: The medieval castle was completely surrounded by a deep, water-filled moat.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪城堡被一条注满水的深护城河完全包围。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于历史建筑或防御语境；商业中常用 economic moat 隐喻企业的“护城河”竞争壁垒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a beguiler who leads someone into danger (usually as part of a plot)

examples.en: The police officer acted as a decoy to catch the serial mugger.
examples.zh: 这名警官充当诱饵，以抓捕连环抢劫犯。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，指用作诱饵的假人、仿制物或起诱导作用的人，常与 act as a decoy 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: lure or entrap with or as if with a decoy

examples.en: They managed to decoy the enemy forces away from the main camp.
examples.zh: 他们设法引开敌军主力，使其远离大营。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词，强调通过诡计或诱饵引诱某人或动物，常与 into 或 away from 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decoy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雉鸡, 野鸡, 雉科鸟
lemmas.def_en: large long-tailed gallinaceous bird native to the Old World but introduced elsewhere

examples.en: A male pheasant with bright plumage suddenly darted out of the bushes.
examples.zh: 一只羽毛鲜艳的雄雉鸡突然从灌木丛中窜了出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指雉鸡或其肉；作活禽时可数，作野味料理时常作不可数名词，多见于狩猎与烹饪语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pheasant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: indicate by signs

examples.en: The sharp drop in quarterly sales does not bode well for the company's future.
examples.zh: 季度销售额的急剧下降对该公司的前景而言并非好兆头。

lemmas.usage_note: 高度书面语及固定搭配动词，常与 well 或 ill 连用，构成 bode well/ill for 表示“预兆好/坏”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 双的, 复式的, 双联的, 二重的, 二倍的
lemmas.def_en: (used technically of a device or process) having two parts

examples.en: The network utilizes a full duplex system to enable simultaneous two-way data transfer.
examples.zh: 该网络利用全双工系统来实现双向数据的同步传输。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，常修饰通信系统（如 duplex transmission 双工传输）或住房结构（duplex apartment）。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 双重的; 双工操作; 双工的; 双的; 双向的
lemmas.def_en: change into a duplex

examples.en: This office printer can duplex large documents automatically to save paper.
examples.zh: 这台办公打印机可以自动对大型文档进行双面打印以节约用纸。

lemmas.usage_note: 通信与打印技术专业动词，指进行双工操作或在纸张正反两面自动打印，多见于设备说明书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 duplex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 韵律, 抑扬, 调子, 节奏
lemmas.def_en: (prosody) the accent in a metrical foot of verse

examples.en: She was soothed by the gentle cadence of his voice as he read.
examples.zh: 他朗读时那轻柔委婉的抑扬调子让她平静下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语名词，指语音的抑扬顿挫或步速、乐句节奏，常与 of 连用（如 cadence of speech）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cadence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: whitish soft-bodied ant-like social insect that feeds on wood

examples.en: The wooden foundation of the old house was severely weakened by termites.
examples.zh: 这座老房子的木质地基被白蚁严重蛀空破坏。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指白蚁，常与 infestation（虫害）或 damage 搭配，多用于房屋检查和生物学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 termite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美洲变色蜥蜴, 善变的人
lemmas.def_en: a changeable or inconstant person

examples.en: He is a political chameleon who changes his opinions to suit the crowd.
examples.zh: 他是一个政治变色龙，总是根据听众的喜好来改变自己的观点。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既指变色龙，也可比喻立场或性格多变的人，常与 political 等词搭配（如政治变色龙）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chameleon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 想得到的, 可想象的, 可理解的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being imagined

examples.en: The rescue team explored every conceivable way to reach the trapped miners.
examples.zh: 救援队尝试了所有想得到的方法去营救受困矿工。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于名词后加强语气，与every搭配构成in every conceivable way，表示“尽一切可能的”。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being conceivable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conceivable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a confused multitude of things

examples.en: Our travel arrangements are in a terrible muddle because of the sudden flight cancellation.
examples.zh: 由于航班突然取消，我们的旅行安排陷入了一团混乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 指秩序混乱或思维困惑的状态，常与in a搭配，如be in a complete muddle（一团糟）。

lemmas.def_zh: 混合, 使微醉, 使咬字不清晰；胡乱对付
lemmas.def_en: make into a puddle

examples.en: I always muddle up the names of the two identical twins.
examples.zh: 我总是把这对同卵双胞胎的名字搞混。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于muddle up表示“弄混/弄乱”，或与through搭配构成muddle through表示“勉强应付过去”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 农宅周围的田园, 耕地, 内野
lemmas.def_en: the area of a baseball field that is enclosed by 3 bases and home plate

examples.en: The batter hit a soft ground ball directly toward the infield.
examples.zh: 击球手击出一记软绵绵的滚地球，直奔内野而去。

lemmas.usage_note: 棒球或板球术语指“内野”及其守备队员；传统农业语境中指宅舍附近的耕地。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a person who plays a position in the infield

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 市政委员会委员, 高级市政官
lemmas.def_en: a member of a municipal legislative body (as a city council)

examples.en: The local alderman proposed a new municipal ordinance to regulate downtown traffic.
examples.zh: 当地市政委员提出了一项规范市中心交通的新市政条例。

lemmas.usage_note: 英美地方政府体制中的高级议员或高级行政官员，为正式行政与政治语体词汇。

lemmas.def_zh: 市议员的, 市府参事的, 市长助理的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or like an alderman

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alderman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: briefly giving the gist of something

examples.en: She gave a succinct summary of the complex financial report in three minutes.
examples.zh: 她在三分钟内对这份复杂的财务报告作了简明扼要的总结。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词，常修饰explanation、summary、account等，强调言简意赅、无冗余信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 简洁地; 简洁地, 简便地
lemmas.def_en: with concise and precise brevity; to the point

examples.en: Please state your case as succinctly as possible
he wrote compactly but clearly

lemmas.def_en: terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words

family_guide.root_logic: 以 succinct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对开纸, 页码, (原稿的)一页
lemmas.def_en: the system of numbering pages

examples.en: The rare book collector acquired a first folio edition of Shakespeare's plays.
examples.zh: 这位珍本书籍收藏家购得了一部莎士比亚戏剧的第一对开本。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于出版、古籍收藏及会计学领域，指大开本对开纸、早期印刷善本或账册一页。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 法警, 郡副司法长官, 乡长
lemmas.def_en: an officer of the court who is employed to execute writs and processes and make arrests etc.

examples.en: The judge instructed the bailiff to escort the unruly spectator out of the courtroom.
examples.zh: 法官命令法警将不守规矩的旁听人员押解出法庭。

lemmas.usage_note: 司法体系中指法庭法警或执行没收财产的执行官；历史英国语境亦指庄园管家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bailiff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity a cask will hold

examples.en: The whiskey was aged in an oak cask for over twelve years.
examples.zh: 这种威士忌在橡木桶中陈酿了十二年以上。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指用于酿造、陈酿及储存酒类（如威士忌、葡萄酒）的木桶，常带容量或材质修饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cask 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cardiovascular disease characterized by a saclike widening of an artery resulting from weakening of the artery wall

examples.en: Doctors performed emergency surgery to repair the ruptured aortic aneurysm.
examples.zh: 医生进行了紧急手术以修复破裂的主动脉瘤。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业名词，指动脉壁薄弱处异常扩张形成的瘤，常与ruptured、brain等连用。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or affected by an aneurysm

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aneurysm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: withdraw from active service

examples.en: The government decided to decommission the aging nuclear power plant next year.
examples.zh: 政府决定在明年正式退役这座老旧的核电站。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于军舰、战机、武器系统或核设施，意为“正式停用、退役或拆除”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decommission 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 6th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The physicist used the symbol zeta to represent the damping ratio in the mechanical equation.
examples.zh: 物理学家使用符号泽塔（zeta）来表示力学方程中的阻尼比。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，专指希腊字母表第六个字母，常用于数学、物理或命名变量等学术与科技语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zeta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the divisor of a fraction

examples.en: To add these two fractions, you must first find a common denominator.
examples.zh: 要把这两个分数相加，你必须先求出公分母。

lemmas.usage_note: 数学名词指分母；引申常用于短语 common denominator（共同特征、公分母），多见于书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denominator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required

examples.en: The charity faced a budget shortfall of nearly fifty thousand dollars by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 到年底，该慈善机构面临近五万美元的预算缺口。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用名词，指实际与预期之间的差额或短缺，常与 budget、revenue 搭配，后接 in/of。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shortfall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当的, 不理智的, 笨拙的
lemmas.def_en: not elegant or graceful in expression

examples.en: He proved completely inept at handling customer complaints, often making the situation worse.
examples.zh: 事实证明他在处理客户投诉方面极其笨拙，往往使局面更加恶化。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰人或其行为，表示笨拙、无能或不恰当，常与 at 连用，多含贬义。

lemmas.def_en: unskillfulness resulting from a lack of training

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当, 不符合要求, 不恰当, 不合场面, 笨拙, 愚蠢, 无能, 不称职
lemmas.def_en: with ineptitude; in an incompetent manner

examples.en: he performed his functions ineptly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inept 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: electrical device designed to receive a specific signal and automatically transmit a specific reply

examples.en: Air traffic control lost radar contact after the aircraft's transponder was mysteriously switched off.
examples.zh: 在飞机上的应答机被神秘关闭后，空中交通管制失去了雷达信号。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技名词，指航空、航海或电信领域中的应答机，常搭配 turn on/off 或 squawk。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transponder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bind by or as if by indentures, as of an apprentice or servant

examples.en: The museum displayed an ancient indenture that outlined terms of land ownership.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一份概述土地所有权条款的古老契据。

lemmas.def_zh: 切割成锯齿状；缩排, 定货, 印凹痕
lemmas.def_en: set in from the margin

examples.en: Please indent the first line of every paragraph by half an inch in your essay.
examples.zh: 请在你的论文中将每个段落的首行缩进半英寸。

lemmas.usage_note: 排版及编辑领域高频动词，常与 by 或空格数连用，表示段落首行缩进；也可指使表面凹陷。

lemmas.def_zh: 契约, 契据, 凹痕
lemmas.def_en: a concave cut into a surface or edge (as in a coastline)

examples.en: The museum displayed an ancient indenture that outlined terms of land ownership.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一份概述土地所有权条款的古老契据。

lemmas.def_zh: 呈锯齿状, 缩排, 缺口, 印凹痕
lemmas.def_en: a concave cut into a surface or edge (as in a coastline)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: erosion by friction

examples.en: The company reduced its workforce through natural attrition rather than resorting to mass layoffs.
examples.zh: 公司通过自然减员来精简员工规模，而不是诉诸大规模裁员。

lemmas.usage_note: 抽象名词，常见搭配 a war of attrition（消耗战）或 natural attrition（自然减员），书面语常用。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by attrition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attrition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical agent for use in chemical reactions

examples.en: Add the liquid reagent carefully to the test tube until a distinct color change occurs.
examples.zh: 请小心地将液体试剂加入试管中，直到出现明显的颜色变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学专业名词，指用于化学反应以检测、测量或制备其他物质的试剂，常见于实验报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reagent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a friend or comrade

examples.en: Thanks for helping me move the couch into the living room, amigo.
examples.zh: 朋友，多谢你帮我把沙发搬进客厅。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语及非正式语体名词，源自西班牙语，常用于熟人之间亲切或诙谐的称呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amigo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 毁损...的外形, 玷污, 损害, 毁损...的容貌
lemmas.def_en: mar or spoil the appearance of

examples.en: The historic building was disfigured by ugly spray paint during the nighttime protest.
examples.zh: 这座历史建筑在夜间抗议活动中被难看的喷漆破坏了外观。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指破坏容貌或外形美观，常用于被动语态，与 by 搭配，多描述火灾、事故等创伤。

lemmas.def_en: an appearance that has been spoiled or is misshapen

examples.en: there were distinguishing disfigurements on the suspect's back
suffering from facial disfiguration

lemmas.def_en: an appearance that has been spoiled or is misshapen

examples.en: there were distinguishing disfigurements on the suspect's back
suffering from facial disfiguration

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disfigure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any small spherical group of cells containing a cavity

examples.en: Inflammation around the hair follicle can cause persistent redness and itching.
examples.zh: 毛囊周围的炎症可能会导致持续的发红和瘙痒。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学与医学专业词汇，常用于 hair follicle（毛囊）或 ovarian follicle（卵泡）等固定搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 小囊的, 滤泡的, 卵泡的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or constituting a follicle

examples.en: The doctor monitored her follicular development using an ultrasound scan during the cycle.
examples.zh: 医生在此周期内通过超声扫描监测了她的卵泡发育情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 follicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shake with fast, tremulous movements

examples.en: Her lips began to quiver as she struggled to hold back her tears.
examples.zh: 当她努力强忍泪水时，嘴唇开始微微颤抖。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语与文学语境，常与 with 搭配表示因恐惧、激动或寒冷而发生细微颤动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quiver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 图上未标明的, 未知的
lemmas.def_en: (of unknown regions) not yet surveyed or investigated

examples.en: The startup is venturing into uncharted territory with its new AI service.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司正凭借其全新的AI服务进军未知领域。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 waters、territory 等词，既指地图未标明的水域，也常比喻未涉足的新领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uncharted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: citrus tree bearing large round edible fruit having a thick yellow rind and juicy somewhat acid pulp

examples.en: She enjoys half a grapefruit and a cup of black coffee for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐喜欢吃半个葡萄柚并喝一杯黑咖啡。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常生活高频词，单复数同形或加-s，常用于饮食健康语境，如 grapefruit juice（西柚汁）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grapefruit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a silver-white metallic element of the platinum group that resembles platinum; occurs in some copper and nickel ores; does not tarnish at ordinary temperatures and is used (alloyed with gold) in jewelry

examples.en: Palladium is widely used as a catalyst in automotive exhaust systems.
examples.zh: 钯被广泛用作汽车尾气排放系统中的催化剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要作为化学和工业用语，多指稀有贵金属或催化剂；大写时可比喻保障物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palladium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very good

examples.en: He came up with a nifty little trick to organize desktop icons quickly.
examples.zh: 他想出了一个巧妙的小窍门，可以快速整理桌面图标。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语和非正式语体词汇，常用来形容小巧巧妙的小工具、实用想法或时髦的设计。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nifty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谦逊地, 卑贱地, 低声下气地
lemmas.def_en: in a humble manner

examples.en: The scientist humbly acknowledged that the discovery was a team effort.
examples.zh: 这位科学家谦逊地承认，这项发现是团队共同努力的结果。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰 apologize、accept、admit 等动词，常用于正式或谦虚客气的书面及口语表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humbly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not anticipated; - H.W.Glidden

examples.en: The flight was delayed due to unforeseen weather conditions.
examples.zh: 航班由于未预见到的天气状况而延误。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语词汇，多作定语，常与 circumstances、problems、events 搭配表示突发意外。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unforeseen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 非常不幸地, 可悲地, 贫困地
lemmas.def_en: in a miserable manner

examples.en: Despite their extensive preparations, the experimental project failed miserably.
examples.zh: 尽管他们做了充分的准备，这个实验性项目还是彻底失败了。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语，常与 fail 连用构成固定搭配 fail miserably（惨败），亦可修饰生活状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miserably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 费边式的, 拖延时间的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Fabianism

examples.en: The defense team adopted Fabian tactics to wear down the opposition's resources.
examples.zh: 辩护团队采取了拖延战术，以逐步消耗对方的资源。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治、历史及战略语境中的书面语，多大写，常与 strategy、tactics 连用表示拖延战术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fabian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发狂地, 精神失常地, 愚蠢地
lemmas.def_en: in an uncontrolled manner

examples.en: They fell madly in love after working together on that brief summer project.
examples.zh: 在那个短暂的夏季项目合作之后，他们陷入了热恋之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰动词或形容词，用于非正式语体中表示程度极深或举止狂乱，常见搭配有 madly in love 和 laugh madly。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 madly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大体育馆, 大剧场,大公共娱乐场
lemmas.def_en: an oval large stadium with tiers of seats; an arena in which contests and spectacles are held

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans gathered inside the coliseum to watch the national championship game.
examples.zh: 数以千计激动的球迷聚集在大型体育馆内观看全国冠军赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作为可数名词指大型露天剧场或现代综合体育馆，常以大写形式出现在场馆专有名词中，语体较正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coliseum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法忍受的, 难耐的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being put up with

examples.en: The summer heat in the poorly ventilated attic became completely intolerable by noon.
examples.zh: 通风不良的阁楼里的夏日酷暑到了中午变得完全无法忍受。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，多用于书面语中形容痛苦、压力、噪音或行为达到极限而难以忍受，常修饰 pain, burden 或 condition。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intolerable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝
lemmas.def_en: a disposition to remain inactive or inert

examples.en: The proposed reforms failed to advance due to deep-seated bureaucratic inertia within the agency.
examples.zh: 由于该机构内部根深蒂固的官僚惰性，提议的改革未能推进。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既作物理术语指惯性，也用于社会或心理语境指惰性与推诿，常见搭配有 institutional inertia 与 bureaucratic inertia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inertia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a regional term for `creature' (especially for domestic animals)

examples.en: We set humane traps in the garden to catch whatever critter was digging up our vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里放置了人道捕捉夹，想逮住把蔬菜刨出来的小动物。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语与非正式方言名词，通常指小动物或野生生物，偶尔诙谐或贬损地指人，常带有一种戏谑或亲昵的感情色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 critter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong man of exceptional physical endurance

examples.en: Completing three ultra-marathons in a single month proved that he was a true ironman.
examples.zh: 在一个月内完成三场超级马拉松证明了他是一个名副其实的铁人。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于体育语境指耐力超群的运动员（如铁人三项参赛者），亦可指意志极坚强之人；若指超级英雄通常写作两个词并大写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ironman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 广场, 阳台, 柱廊, 走廊, 露天市场
lemmas.def_en: a public square with room for pedestrians

examples.en: Tourists and locals mingled freely while sipping espresso in the lively village piazza.
examples.zh: 游客和当地人在热闹的村庄广场上边喝意式浓缩咖啡边自在交谈。

lemmas.usage_note: 借自意大利语，多指欧洲（尤其是意大利）城镇的公共露天广场；在美式英语方言中也可指房屋外部的带顶走廊或大门廊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piazza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of killing someone painlessly (especially someone suffering from an incurable illness)

examples.en: The parliament held a passionate debate on whether to legalize euthanasia for terminally ill patients.
examples.zh: 议会就绝症患者安乐死是否合法化展开了激烈的辩论。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要用于医学、法律及伦理等严肃语境，常见搭配有 active/passive euthanasia 或 practice euthanasia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 euthanasia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to double the degree

examples.en: Her unexpected success made the family doubly proud of all her hard work.
examples.zh: 她出人意料的成功让全家人为她的所有辛勤付出感到加倍骄傲。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰形容词（如 difficult, sure, important），表示程度提高为两倍或具有双重性质，书面语与口语均常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doubly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being dishonest

examples.en: The accountant was dismissed immediately after an internal audit exposed his deliberate dishonesty.
examples.zh: 在内部审计揭露了其蓄意欺骗的行为后，该会计师立即被解雇了。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数抽象名词，表示欺骗、不老实的行为或品质，常见搭配有 financial dishonesty 与 accuse someone of dishonesty。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dishonesty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is a council member

examples.en: The local councilman promised to address the community's concerns regarding traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 这位地方市议员承诺解决社区关切的交通拥堵问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指地方或城市议会的男性成员，常与 elected、local 连用，语体偏向正式新闻与政务报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 councilman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 关系, 融洽, 一致
lemmas.def_en: a relationship of mutual understanding or trust and agreement between people

examples.en: She quickly established a good rapport with her new colleagues during the orientation week.
examples.zh: 她在入职培训周期间迅速与新同事建立了融洽的关系。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示融洽、和谐的关系，多用于职场与社交语境，常与 build、establish、have 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapport 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 秘教的, 奥秘的, 秘传的
lemmas.def_en: confined to and understandable by only an enlightened inner circle

examples.en: The professor's lecture focused on the esoteric philosophical theories of the late medieval period.
examples.zh: 教授的讲座聚焦于中世纪晚期深奥晦涩的哲学理论。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰仅少数人懂的深奥知识或概念，常与 knowledge、subject、jargon 等词搭配，语体正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 esoteric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 基本的, 起码的, 初步的, 发展不完全的, 残留的, 退化的
lemmas.def_en: being or involving basic facts or principles

examples.en: Even with only a rudimentary grasp of Spanish, she managed to ask the locals for directions.
examples.zh: 即便只掌握了最基本的西班牙语，她还是设法向当地人问了路。

lemmas.usage_note: 指处于最基础或未充分发展的状态，常修饰 knowledge、skills、tools，多见于书面语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 基础, 入门, 雏形, 退化器官
lemmas.def_en: the elementary stages of any subject (usually plural)

examples.en: Students must master the rudiments of programming before moving on to complex algorithms.
examples.zh: 学生在学习复杂算法之前，必须掌握编程的基础知识。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rudimentary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sweetened mixture of milk and eggs baked or boiled or frozen

examples.en: She poured warm, creamy custard over the freshly baked apple pie before serving dessert.
examples.zh: 在端上甜点之前，她将温热细腻的蛋奶沙司淋在刚出炉的苹果派上。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指蛋奶甜沙司，作可数名词指特定蛋奶甜点，常与 bake、serve 等烹饪动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 custard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a French river that flows through the heart of Paris and then northward into the English Channel

examples.en: The fishermen cast their large seine into the bay at dawn to trap migrating mackerel.
examples.zh: 渔民们拂晓时分将巨大的围网撒入海湾，以捕捉迁徙中的鲭鱼。

lemmas.usage_note: 指垂直悬挂在水中的大型捕鱼围网或曳网，多用于海洋渔业术语，常与 cast、haul 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of the clergy and a spiritual leader of the Christian Church

examples.en: The local clergyman performed the wedding ceremony in the historic village church.
examples.zh: 当地的牧师在具有历史底蕴的乡村教堂里主持了婚礼仪式。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指基督教的男性神职人员或牧师，属正式书面语体，常与 ordained、local 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clergyman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very close or connected in space or time

examples.en: The two nature reserves are contiguous, forming a vast protected corridor for wildlife migration.
examples.zh: 这两个自然保护区彼此相连，构成了一条供野生动物迁徙的广袤保护走廊。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示地理或空间上的彼此接触或紧邻，常用搭配为 contiguous with/to，多见于政经与地理文本。

lemmas.def_en: the attribute of being so near as to be touching

examples.en: The territorial contiguity of the allied nations greatly aided their mutual defense efforts.
examples.zh: 同盟国之间的领土邻近极大地帮助了他们的共同防御工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contiguous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dreamy romantic or sentimental quality

examples.en: The classic Hollywood movie star brought an undeniable touch of stardust to the charity gala.
examples.zh: 这位好莱坞老牌影星为慈善晚会带来了一抹无可否认的梦幻光环。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于不可数形式，字面指星尘，比喻引人入胜的浪漫魅力或梦幻光环，常作文学修辞表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stardust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the right side of a ship or aircraft to someone who is aboard and facing the bow or nose

examples.en: The lookout spotted a pod of dolphins surfacing gracefully on the starboard of the vessel.
examples.zh: 瞭望员发现一群海豚在船只的右舷优雅地跃出水面。

lemmas.usage_note: 航海及航空专用术语，指船只或飞行器的右舷，常与介词 to 或 on 构成方位短语搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to ripen or develop fully

examples.en: Warm sunshine and gentle rain helped the tomatoes ripen quickly on the vine.
examples.zh: 温暖的阳光和细雨促使藤上的番茄迅速成熟。

lemmas.usage_note: 兼作及物与不及物动词，常与 fruit, crop 或 conditions 搭配，用于果实成熟或时机成熟。

lemmas.def_en: not fully developed or mature; not ripe

examples.en: unripe fruit
fried green tomatoes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ripen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: exact a tithe from

examples.en: Devout villagers were expected to tithe a portion of their annual harvest to the church.
examples.zh: 虔诚的村民们被要求将每年收成的一部分作为什一税缴纳给教会。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教或历史语境动词，表示按十分之一纳税或征税，常接收入或农产品作宾语，亦可作不及物动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tithe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牦牛, 饶舌, 连篇废话
lemmas.def_en: noisy talk

examples.en: Local herders rely heavily on the domestic yak for milk, wool, and heavy transport.
examples.zh: 当地牧民极大地依赖家养牦牛来获取奶、羊毛以及进行重载运输。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词可指青藏高原特有的长毛家畜牦牛；口语中亦可指没完没了的闲扯或废话，属非正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 饶舌, 喋喋不休, 放声大笑
lemmas.def_en: talk profusely

examples.en: She sat behind me on the train and yakked on her phone for the entire two-hour journey.
examples.zh: 在火车上她坐在我后面，整整两个小时的行程都在打电话唠叨个不停。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语非正式动词，常与 on, about 连用，表示没完没了地唠叨、闲扯或饶舌，常带厌烦情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any instruction that works first one way and then the other; it turns something on the first time it is used and then turns it off the next time

examples.en: Fasten the duffle coat using the wooden toggle attached to the leather loop.
examples.zh: 用系在皮圈上的木质套索扣系好这件牛角扣大衣。

lemmas.usage_note: 指大衣上的牛角扣、机械定位销，或现代计算机界面中可切换两态的转换开关键。

lemmas.def_en: provide with a toggle or toggles

examples.en: You can press this keyboard shortcut to toggle between full screen and windowed mode.
examples.zh: 你可以按下这个快捷键在全屏和窗口模式之间进行切换。

lemmas.usage_note: 技术语境及物或不及物动词，常与 between 连用，表示在两种状态或模式之间切换，或用扣子扣牢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chromatic purity: freedom from dilution with white and hence vivid in hue

examples.en: The artist increased the chroma of the digital painting to make the sunset look more vibrant.
examples.zh: 艺术家提高了这幅数码画作的色品度，使日落显得更加鲜艳生动。

lemmas.usage_note: 色彩学与图像处理专业术语，指颜色的饱和度、纯度或色品度，常与 keying, subsampling 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of a color as determined by its dominant wavelength

lemmas.def_zh: 彩色的, 色品的, 易染色的
lemmas.def_en: able to refract light without spectral color separation

examples.en: chromatic lens

lemmas.def_en: with respect to color

examples.en: chromatically pure

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chroma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: common black-and-grey Eurasian bird noted for thievery

examples.en: A lone daw perched on the crumbling church steeple, calling into the misty morning.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的寒鸦栖息在破败的教堂尖顶上，对着薄雾笼罩的清晨啼鸣。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或传统语境中的鸟类名词，指寒鸦（通常写作 jackdaw），常象征叫声嘈杂的小型鸦科鸟类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin

examples.en: A cluster of pale freckles stood out across the bridge of her nose after a day in the sun.
examples.zh: 晒了一天太阳后，她鼻梁上显现出一簇浅浅的雀斑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指皮肤上的浅褐色斑点或雀斑，常作复数 freckles，搭配 across the nose 等。

lemmas.def_en: become freckled

examples.en: Fair skin tends to freckle easily when exposed to harsh summer sunlight without sunscreen.
examples.zh: 白皙的皮肤在不涂防晒霜暴露于强烈的夏日阳光下时往往容易长出雀斑。

lemmas.usage_note: 兼作及物与不及物动词，指（阳光使皮肤）生出斑点，或使表面布满斑点，常用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freckle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 霹雳, 雷电, 晴天霹雳, 怒喝
lemmas.def_en: a discharge of lightning accompanied by thunder

examples.en: The sudden announcement of the factory closure hit the small town like a thunderbolt.
examples.zh: 工厂突然关闭的消息犹如晴天霹雳，重重击中了这个小镇。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词指伴随雷声的雷电或霹雳；比喻用法常与 like a 搭配，表示令人极其震惊的突发消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thunderbolt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浸水, 泛滥, 淹没, 使充满
lemmas.def_en: fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid

examples.en: Customer service agents were inundated with complaints following the nationwide network outage.
examples.zh: 全国性网络中断发生后，客服人员被铺天盖地的投诉淹没了。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指洪水淹没土地，更常以被动语态 be inundated with 形式比喻应接不暇。

lemmas.def_zh: 淹水, 洪水, 大水
lemmas.def_en: the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land

examples.en: plains fertilized by annual inundations

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inundate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an enveloping or covering membrane or layer of body tissue

examples.en: Roman soldiers wore a durable woolen tunic beneath their heavy iron armor.
examples.zh: 罗马士兵在厚重的铁甲里面穿了一件结实的羊毛短袍。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指古希腊罗马宽松短袍、现代女性宽松长罩衫，或军警制服上装，多为套头短袖或无袖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tunic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使兴高采烈, 使得意
lemmas.def_en: fill with high spirits; fill with optimism

examples.en: The unexpected promotion seemed to elate him beyond words.
examples.zh: 这次意外的升职似乎让他兴奋得难以言表。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态或及物动词结构，表示外在事物使人精神振奋、得意，属文学或正式书面语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 得意洋洋, 兴高采烈
lemmas.def_en: an exhilarating psychological state of pride and optimism; an absence of depression

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any heavy material used to stabilize a ship or airship

examples.en: The ship took on tons of water as ballast before setting out to sea.
examples.zh: 这艘船在出海前装载了数吨水作为压舱物。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指维持船只、气球平衡的实体压舱物，也常用于比喻稳定人心或局势的基石，多作不可数名词。

lemmas.def_en: make steady with a ballast

examples.en: Workers labored through the night to ballast the newly laid railroad tracks.
examples.zh: 工人们彻夜奋战，为新铺设的铁轨铺填道碴。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给船只装压舱物，或在铁轨下铺道碴，引申为提供心理或经济支撑，多用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: living quarters reserved for wives and concubines and female relatives in a Muslim household

examples.en: The sultan kept a large harem within the secluded palace walls.
examples.zh: 苏丹在深宫高墙之内养着庞大的后宫妻妾。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既指伊斯兰传统中女性居住的闺房，也指妻妾群或群居动物的雌性群体，常与介词 of 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: laugh quietly

examples.en: Several students snickered at the back of the classroom during the lecture.
examples.zh: 讲座进行时，教室后排的几个学生忍不住偷偷笑了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物或及物动词，指压抑或不怀好意地窃笑，常与介词 at 连用，多用于口语与文学叙述中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snicker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能辨别的, 不能区别的
lemmas.def_en: exactly alike; incapable of being perceived as different

examples.en: The counterfeit banknotes were virtually indistinguishable from genuine ones.
examples.zh: 这些伪钞与真钞几乎别无二致，难以辨识。

lemmas.usage_note: 表语或定语形容词，表示事物间极其相似而难以区分，常与介词 from 搭配，属正式用语。

lemmas.def_en: exact sameness

examples.en: they shared an identity of interests

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indistinguishable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没用的人, 幼虫, 卵
lemmas.def_en: a luminance unit equal to 1 candle per square meter measured perpendicular to the rays from the source

examples.en: The school nurse carefully inspected the children's hair for lice and nits.
examples.zh: 校医仔细检查了孩子们头发里是否有头虱和虱卵。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指虱子等的卵；英式口语中常作轻蔑语，指笨蛋或没用的人，衍生出 nitpick 等词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical used to kill insects

examples.en: Farmers are encouraged to reduce their reliance on chemical insecticides.
examples.zh: 农民们被鼓励减少对化学杀虫剂的依赖。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业及农业用语，指杀虫剂，可作可数或不可数名词，常见搭配有 spray/apply insecticide。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insecticide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血小板, 小盘, 小板
lemmas.def_en: tiny bits of protoplasm found in vertebrate blood; essential for blood clotting

examples.en: Blood platelets play a vital role in forming clots to stop bleeding.
examples.zh: 血小板在形成血栓以止血的过程中起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与生物学专业名词，指血液中的血小板，常以复数形式出现，搭配如 platelet count（血小板计数）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 platelet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small rapid variations in a waveform resulting from fluctuations in the voltage supply or mechanical vibrations or other sources

examples.en: High network jitter caused noticeable lag during the video conference.
examples.zh: 高网络抖动导致视频会议期间出现了明显的延迟。

lemmas.usage_note: 技术语境下为单数不可数名词，指信号或网络抖动；日常复数 jitters 特指紧张不安的情绪。

lemmas.def_zh: 神经过敏, 战战兢兢
lemmas.def_en: the anxious feeling you have when you have the jitters
characterized by jerky movements

examples.en: a jittery ride

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jitter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高贵的人, 高官, 高僧, 要人
lemmas.def_en: an important or influential (and often overbearing) person

examples.en: Foreign dignitaries were invited to attend the state banquet tonight.
examples.zh: 多位外国政要获邀出席了今晚的国宴。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指因位高权重而备受尊敬的高官、要人或宗教显要，常用于外交、政务新闻等正式语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dignitary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short high tone produced as a signal or warning

examples.en: A steady bleep from the heart monitor reassured the anxious family.
examples.zh: 心电监护仪发出的规律哔哔声让焦急的家属安心下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指电子设备发出的短促清脆声，多作可数名词，常见搭配如 hear a faint bleep。

lemmas.def_en: emit a single short high-pitched signal

examples.en: The sensor began to bleep loudly as the car backed closer to the wall.
examples.zh: 当汽车倒车越来越靠近墙壁时，传感器开始大声发出哔哔声。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指仪器发声或用蜂鸣声屏蔽粗话，及物时多与 out 搭配，不及物表示发出哔哔声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bleep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small balls or strips of boiled or steamed dough

examples.en: She served a rich beef stew topped with light, fluffy dumplings.
examples.zh: 她端上了一道浓郁的炖牛肉，上面配有松软可口的面团布丁。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指中式饺子或西式面团布丁，多用作可数名词，常与 steam、boil 等烹饪动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dumpling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an official report (usually sent in haste)

examples.en: The military headquarters awaited an urgent despatch from the front lines.
examples.zh: 军事指挥部正在等待来自前线的一封紧急公文。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 dispatch 的英式拼写，常指公文速递或电讯，搭配 with despatch 表示迅速地。

lemmas.def_en: send away towards a designated goal

examples.en: The courier company agreed to despatch the parcels before noon tomorrow.
examples.zh: 快递公司同意在明天中午之前把这批包裹寄送出去。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指派遣人员、寄发邮件或货物，多接代词或名词作宾语，属于正式书面语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 despatch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cry like a cat

examples.en: The hungry kitten began to mew softly by the empty food bowl.
examples.zh: 饥饿的小猫在空空的饭碗旁开始轻轻地咪咪叫。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指猫咪低声呜咽或海鸥鸣叫，作关押义时多用被动语态 mewed up，略带文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: read anew; read again

examples.en: I often reread the final chapter to fully understand the author's hidden message.
examples.zh: 我经常重读最后一章，以充分理解作者隐藏的深意。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示重新阅读或反复研读，及物动词，常接 book、letter、passage 等名词作宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reread 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the descendants of one individual

examples.en: The breeder carefully documented the horse's lineage to prove its pure bloodline.
examples.zh: 繁育者仔细记录了这匹马的谱系，以证明其纯正的血统。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指人或动植物的血统与传承谱系，多作可数名词，常见搭配如 pure bloodline。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不连贯的, 语无伦次的
lemmas.def_en: without logical or meaningful connection

examples.en: Shocked by the news, the witness gave an incoherent account of the accident.
examples.zh: 受到消息的惊吓，目击者对事故的描述显得语无伦次。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰言语、思维或文章，表示语无伦次或缺乏逻辑，常与 murmur、speech 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: in an incoherent manner

examples.en: he talked incoherently when he drank too much

lemmas.def_zh: 无凝聚性, 松散, 支离破碎, 不连贯, 语无伦次, 无条理
lemmas.def_en: lack of cohesion or clarity or organization

examples.en: Exhaustion caused noticeable incoherence in the exhausted politician's late-night speech.
examples.zh: 筋疲力尽导致这位疲惫的政客在深夜演讲中语无伦次。

lemmas.def_en: lack of cohesion or clarity or organization

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incoherent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to run in panic

examples.en: A sudden crack of thunder stampeded the herd across the open plain.
examples.zh: 一声突如其来的雷响使这群牲畜惊恐地穿过开阔的平原。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指群体惊逃或蜂拥而入，常与 into、towards 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stampede 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance capable of reducing friction by making surfaces smooth or slippery

examples.en: The mechanic applied a generous amount of lube to the squeaky bicycle chain.
examples.zh: 修理工在吱吱作响的自行车链条上涂抹了大量的润滑油。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 lubricant 的口语简称，多指机械润滑油或医用润滑剂，通常作不可数名词使用。

lemmas.def_en: apply a lubricant to

examples.en: Make sure you lube the moving parts regularly to prevent rust and friction.
examples.zh: 务必定期给活动部件加润滑油，以防止生锈和摩擦。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示给机械或部件添加润滑油，为口语用法，常接零件或轴承作宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lube 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process

examples.en: Astronomers detected the brilliant light emitted by a distant supernova.
examples.zh: 天文学家探测到了遥远超新星爆发时释放出的耀眼光芒。

lemmas.usage_note: 天文学专业术语，指发生剧烈爆炸的超新星，复数形式可用 supernovae 或 supernovas。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supernova 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wild or domesticated South American cud-chewing animal related to camels but smaller and lacking a hump

examples.en: The Andean farmers rely on the llama for carrying heavy loads across rugged mountain trails.
examples.zh: 安第斯山脉的农民依靠美洲驼在崎岖的山路上驮运重物。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指原产于南美洲的羊驼/美洲驼，常与 wool、spit 等词连用，用于动物或畜牧语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 llama 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 畏缩, 退缩, 畏首畏尾
lemmas.def_en: draw back, as with fear or pain

examples.en: He did not flinch from speaking the truth, even when threatened with severe penalties.
examples.zh: 即使面临严厉惩罚的威胁，他也未曾退缩，依然坚持讲出真相。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，常与 from 连用（flinch from doing sth 表示退缩），多用于否定句表现勇敢坚定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flinch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a toiletry applied to the skin in order to mask unpleasant odors

examples.en: Remember to apply deodorant before heading out to the gym for your workout.
examples.zh: 去健身房锻炼前，记得涂上除臭止汗剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数或不可数名词，指除臭剂或止汗剂，常见搭配有 roll-on deodorant、apply deodorant。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deodorant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无脊椎的, 无骨气的
lemmas.def_en: lacking a backbone or spinal column

examples.en: The biology class spent the afternoon examining various invertebrate specimens under the microscope.
examples.zh: 生物课上，学生们整个下午都在显微镜下观察各种无脊椎动物标本。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时多置于名词前作定语，生物学指“无脊椎的”，比喻义指人“软弱无骨气的”，语气多含贬义。

lemmas.def_zh: 无脊椎动物, 无骨气的人
lemmas.def_en: any animal lacking a backbone or notochord; the term is not used as a scientific classification

examples.en: Worms and jellyfish are classic examples of invertebrates that thrive in diverse habitats.
examples.zh: 蠕虫和水母是在多样化生境中繁衍生息的典型无脊椎动物。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指无脊椎动物（如昆虫、软体动物），引申用于口语中讥讽毫无决断力或原则的软骨头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invertebrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: steal in a store

examples.en: The teenager was caught attempting to shoplift a pair of wireless headphones from the electronics store.
examples.zh: 这名少年企图从电子产品商店偷窃一副无线耳机时被当场抓获。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指在商店营业期间顺手牵羊盗窃商品，主语多为顾客或小偷，法律与日常通用。

lemmas.def_en: a thief who steals goods that are in a store

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shoplift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a carriage consisting of two wheels and a calash top; drawn by a single horse

examples.en: The country doctor traveled through the muddy lanes in a horse-drawn shay to visit his patients.
examples.zh: 那位乡村医生乘着一辆轻便的双轮单马车穿过泥泞小道去探视病人。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史性名词，源自法语 chaise，特指旧时轻便的双轮单座马车，常见于文学历史读物及老式民谣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 露出, 露头, 爆发
lemmas.def_en: the part of a rock formation that appears above the surface of the surrounding land

examples.en: Hikers rested on a massive rocky outcrop overlooking the entire forest valley.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者在一处俯瞰整片森林山谷的巨大岩石露头上歇脚。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，地质学指岩石或矿脉露出地表的“露头”，也引申指某种现象的突然出现或显现，常与 of 连用。

lemmas.def_en: the part of a rock formation that appears above the surface of the surrounding land
appear on the surface, come to the surface on the ground

examples.en: Layers of fossil-rich limestone outcrop along the rugged coastal cliffs.
examples.zh: 富含化石的石灰岩层沿着崎岖的海岸悬崖露出地表。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指地下矿层或岩石显露于地面，主要用于专业地质报告及地理环境描写中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outcrop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吞, 大口大口地吸气, 吸收, 抑制；吞咽
lemmas.def_en: to swallow hurriedly or greedily or in one draught

examples.en: Thirsty after the marathon, she gulped down two full glasses of cold water.
examples.zh: 马拉松结束后她口渴难耐，大口咽下了整整两杯凉水。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指狼吞虎咽地吞饮，或因紧张倒抽气，常搭配 gulp down（急忙吞下）。

lemmas.def_en: a large and hurried swallow

examples.en: He emptied the entire mug of black coffee in a single hurried gulp.
examples.zh: 他匆忙地一饮而尽，一口气喝完了整杯黑咖啡。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指吞咽的动作或一口吞下的量，常见短语有 in one gulp（一口气吞下）、with a gulp。

lemmas.def_en: a drinker who swallows large amounts greedily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gulp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可理解的, 易理解的, 纯概念性的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being apprehended or understood

examples.en: The professor made complex quantum physics intelligible to beginner students through clear analogies.
examples.zh: 教授通过生动的类比，让复杂的量子物理学对初学者来说变得通俗易懂。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常与介词 to 搭配（intelligible to sb），强调语言、逻辑或概念清晰易懂，区别于感官所及。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法了解的, 难解的, 莫明其妙的
lemmas.def_en: poorly articulated or enunciated, or drowned by noise

examples.en: unintelligible speech

lemmas.def_en: the quality of language that is comprehensible

lemmas.def_zh: 不可懂度, 不清晰性
lemmas.def_en: nonsense that is simply incoherent and unintelligible

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intelligible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花匠, 花商, 花卉研究者
lemmas.def_en: someone who grows and deals in flowers

examples.en: He asked the florist to arrange a bouquet of fresh white lilies for his mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 他请花店店员搭配一束新鲜的白百合，作为给母亲的生日花束。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既可指卖花的花匠、花商，也常加所有格（the florist's）代指花店，属于日常高频词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 florist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage

examples.en: Her family struggled for months to save enough money for a decent dowry.
examples.zh: 为了凑足一份体面的嫁妆，她的家人辛苦积攒了数月。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，指嫁妆或婚资，常与动词 provide、receive 或 pay 搭配，多见于文化与历史叙事中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dowry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a United States liquid unit equal to 32 fluid ounces; four quarts equal one gallon

examples.en: The recipe calls for a quart of fresh milk to make the rich dessert.
examples.zh: 这道食谱需要一夸脱鲜牛奶来制作浓郁的甜点。

lemmas.usage_note: 英美容量单位（约四分之一加仑），常用作可数名词，常见搭配为 a quart of milk/oil 等生活用语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: round flat seed of the lentil plant used for food

examples.en: She cooked a warm and hearty pot of red lentil soup for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐时，她煮了一锅热气腾腾又丰盛的红小扁豆汤。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常以复数形式 lentils 出现，指扁豆或小扁豆，常与 soup、curry 搭配，多用于饮食烹饪语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lentil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蹒跚地走, 摇摇晃晃地走, 摇晃不稳
lemmas.def_en: walk by dragging one's feet

examples.en: Exhausted after the marathon, the runner began to shamble toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 马拉松结束后疲惫不堪，选手拖着沉重的步伐蹒跚走向终点线。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词，指拖着沉重笨拙的脚步蹒跚前行，常与 down、into 等介词连用，具文学描摹色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shamble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any substance that produces cancer

examples.en: Tobacco smoke contains dozens of chemicals identified as a dangerous carcinogen.
examples.zh: 烟草烟雾中含有数十种被认定为危险致癌物的化学物质。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，指致癌物质，常与 known、potential 连用，多出现在医学、环保及公共卫生报告中。

lemmas.def_en: causing or tending to cause cancer

examples.en: the carcinogenic action of certain chemicals

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carcinogen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: transport in a sleigh

examples.en: The excited children sledge down the snowy hillside every winter afternoon.
examples.zh: 每年冬天的下午，兴奋的孩子们都会坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡上滑下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指坐雪橇滑行或用雪橇运送，常与 down the hill 或 across the snow 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sledge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the process of flowing in

examples.en: The government introduced new tax policies to encourage the inflow of foreign capital.
examples.zh: 政府出台了新的税收政策以鼓励外资流入。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，多指资本、现金或外流物质的大规模涌入，常见搭配如 capital inflow，属财经政论词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inflow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 护身符, 驱邪物, 法宝
lemmas.def_en: a trinket or piece of jewelry usually hung about the neck and thought to be a magical protection against evil or disease

examples.en: The old sailor always wore a silver coin around his neck as a protective talisman.
examples.zh: 老水手脖子上总是挂着一枚银币，当作保平安的护身符。

lemmas.usage_note: 指护身符或具有法力的吉祥物，常作比喻义（带来好运之物），复数形式为 talismans，语体略偏正式。

lemmas.def_zh: 护符的, 有护符般效力的
lemmas.def_en: possessing or believed to possess magic power especially protective power

examples.en: a talismanic amulet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 talisman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: headgear for a horse; includes a headstall and bit and reins to give the rider or driver control

examples.en: He gently slipped the leather bridle over the horse's head before the morning ride.
examples.zh: 在晨骑之前，他将皮马勒轻轻套在马头上。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为马勒、辔头，引申指约束或控制，常用于 hold/slip the bridle 或比喻性搭配中，多见于叙事书面语。

lemmas.def_en: anger or take offense

examples.en: The manager seemed to bridle at the suggestion that his leadership was flawed.
examples.zh: 当有人暗示他的领导能力存在缺陷时，经理显得颇为恼怒。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词时常接 at 表示“因…而动怒、昂首表示不悦”；作及物动词表示“抑制、约束（情感或欲望）”。

lemmas.def_en: remove the bridle from (a horse or mule)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bridle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 熄灭, 结束, 使冷却, 将...淬火；熄灭, 平息
lemmas.def_en: satisfy (thirst)

examples.en: A glass of chilled lemonade was all he needed to quench his intense thirst.
examples.zh: 他只需要一杯冰镇柠檬水就能解掉极度的口渴。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，最常与 thirst 连用表示解渴，亦可表示熄灭火焰或压抑欲望、工业淬火，属较书面表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quench 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a landowner

examples.en: The old laird decided to open his estate's gardens to the public during the summer.
examples.zh: 老地主决定在夏季将自己的庄园花园向公众开放。

lemmas.usage_note: 苏格兰特有词汇，指拥有大片领地的地主或庄园主，常带地域文化色彩，多用于苏格兰历史或乡村语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: makeup applied to emphasize the shape of the eyes

examples.en: She carefully applied liquid eyeliner along her upper lashes to create a dramatic look.
examples.zh: 她沿着上睫毛仔细地涂抹液体眼线液，打造出醒目的妆效。

lemmas.usage_note: 美妆常用词，指眼线膏、眼线笔或眼线液等画眼线的化妆品，常与 apply、wear、liquid 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyeliner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood used for fuel

examples.en: They chopped a large stack of firewood to prepare for the harsh winter ahead.
examples.zh: 他们劈了一大堆木柴，为即将到来的严冬做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指供燃烧用的木柴、柴火，常与动词 chop、gather、stack 等连用，常见于日常生活与户外语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firewood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: providence by virtue of planning prudently for the future

examples.en: She had the foresight to invest in renewable energy long before it became popular.
examples.zh: 早在可再生能源流行之前，她就深具远见地投资了该领域。

lemmas.usage_note: 抽象名词，多作不可数，指先见之明、远见卓识，常与 have the foresight to do sth. 连用，多为褒义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foresight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the final stages of an extended process of negotiation

examples.en: The peace negotiations have finally entered the endgame after months of intense debate.
examples.zh: 经过数月激烈的辩论，和平谈判终于进入了最后阶段。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指国际象棋的残局阶段，引申指复杂谈判、政治角力或军事行动的最后阶段或尾声，常与 reach、enter 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endgame 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a carriage for hire

examples.en: He hailed a passing hackney to take him through the foggy streets of Victorian London.
examples.zh: 他拦下一辆路过的出租马车，载着他穿过维多利亚时代雾气蒙蒙的伦敦街道。

lemmas.usage_note: 多见于历史语境或英式英语，指可供出租的马或出租马车（hackney carriage），现多保留在法律或复古文体中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hackney 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 忠诚的, 信仰的, 虔诚的, 祷告的
lemmas.def_en: relating to worship

examples.en: The choir performed a collection of devotional songs during the evening service.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在晚祷仪式上演唱了一组虔诚的宗教赞美诗。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指与宗教祈祷、敬神仪式或虔诚信仰相关的，常修饰 music、literature、practices 等名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devotional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the wife of your father by a subsequent marriage

examples.en: Her stepmother always treated her with patience and supported her artistic dreams.
examples.zh: 她的继母总是耐心地对待她，并支持她的艺术梦想。

lemmas.usage_note: 称谓名词，指父亲的现任妻子（非亲生母亲），常出现在家庭关系或童话故事等语境中，中性词但受文学刻板印象影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepmother 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (in various countries) a son or younger brother or a count

examples.en: The title was passed down to the young viscount after his father's sudden passing.
examples.zh: 在父亲突然离世后，这个爵位传给了年轻的子爵。

lemmas.usage_note: 英国及欧洲贵族爵位词，指子爵（介于伯爵 earl 与男爵 baron 之间），发音中 s 不发音，常作头衔使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viscount 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 26th letter of the Roman alphabet

examples.en: In American English, the last letter of the alphabet is pronounced zee rather than zed.
examples.zh: 在美式英语中，字母表中的最后一个字母读作 zee 而不是 zed。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语中对英文字母 Z 的称呼（英式为 zed），用于口语拼读字母或指代 Z 形结构物，属于地域性拼写标记。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an athlete who has earned a letter in a school sport

examples.en: As a three-sport letterman in high school, he easily earned an athletic scholarship to college.
examples.zh: 作为高中三项运动的校队主力，他轻松赢得了大学的体育奖学金。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美校园英语专有名词，指因代表学校参赛而获得校名缩写字母荣誉标志的优秀运动员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 letterman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 成年, 勇气, 男儿
lemmas.def_en: the state of being a man; manly qualities

examples.en: Enduring such severe hardship was seen as a rite of passage into true manhood.
examples.zh: 承受如此严酷的磨难被视为迈向真正成年期的成年礼。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指男子的成年时期、男子气概或全体成年男子，多用于正式语体中，常搭配 attain 或 test。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manhood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the molecular weight of a substance expressed in grams; the basic unit of amount of substance adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: The reaction requires precisely one mol of hydrogen gas for every mol of oxygen consumed.
examples.zh: 每消耗一摩尔氧气，该反应恰好需要一摩尔氢气。

lemmas.usage_note: 即 mole 的缩写，为化学专业术语，常与具体数值或浓度单位搭配表示物质的量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musical work that has been created

examples.en: The composer spent his final years completing a monumental choral opus that stunned critics.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家在晚年完成了一部令人赞叹的宏大合唱作品。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于艺术与音乐领域指代巨著或编号作品，极常见搭配为 magnum opus（代表作）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 opus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of securities) not traded on a stock exchange

examples.en: You can purchase mild painkillers as otc drugs without a doctor's prescription.
examples.zh: 无需医生处方，你就可以作为非处方药购买温和的止痛药。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母缩略形容词（over-the-counter），常作定语修饰非处方药品或场外金融交易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 otc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 确凿无疑地；不可否认地
lemmas.def_en: to an undeniable degree or in an undeniable manner

examples.en: Her innovative research is undeniably the most groundbreaking work in this field today.
examples.zh: 她的创新研究不可否认是当今该领域最具开创性的工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词作评注性状语或修饰形容词，用于强调事实确凿无疑，多见于论辩和正式书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undeniably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出生以前的, 孕期的
lemmas.def_en: occurring or existing before birth

examples.en: Regular prenatal care is essential for monitoring both the mother's and the baby's health.
examples.zh: 定期的产前检查对监测母婴健康至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学保健用语，常作前置定语修饰 care、diagnosis 或 development，指产前或孕期的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prenatal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: alone and on your own

examples.en: He spent the entire weekend on his tod after all his flatmates went away.
examples.zh: 室友们全走后，他独自一人度过了整个周末。

lemmas.usage_note: 苏格兰及英格兰俚语，专用于短语 on one's tod 中，作表语表示“独自一人的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾向, 爱好, 习性
lemmas.def_en: an inclination to do something

examples.en: He showed an alarming propensity for taking unnecessary financial risks during investments.
examples.zh: 他在投资过程中表现出了过度承担不必要财务风险的惊人倾向。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，表示内在的倾向或习性，尤指不良嗜好，常见结构为 propensity for/to do。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propensity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裁减, 梗概, 夹杀出局
lemmas.def_en: a concluding summary (as in presenting a case before a law court)

examples.en: The manager gave the team a quick rundown of the project's milestones before the launch.
examples.zh: 在项目启动前，经理向团队简要概述了该项目的关键节点。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用单数形式，表示简报或概要，高频搭配为 give sb a rundown on/of sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rundown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 计策, 谋略, 诡计
lemmas.def_en: a deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture)

examples.en: She claimed she was unwell, but it was just a clever ruse to avoid attending the meeting.
examples.zh: 她声称自己身体不适，但这只是为了逃避参会而耍的聪明伎俩。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，指为达到目的而精心设计的花招、诡计，常见搭配如clever ruse或a ruse to do sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ruse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 速记法, 速记, 记录文字
lemmas.def_en: written in abbreviated or symbolic form

examples.en: The journalist quickly checked her shorthand notes to verify the exact words of the speech.
examples.zh: 记者快速核对了她的速记笔记，以确认演讲中的原话。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语修饰名词，表示“速记的”或引申为“简略表达的”，常见搭配如shorthand notes或shorthand typist。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shorthand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a figure of a person made of packed snow

examples.en: The children spent the entire afternoon building a giant snowman in the front yard.
examples.zh: 孩子们在前院花了一整个下午堆了一个巨大的雪人。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与动词build或make连用，多用于冬季或童年生活语境中，指用积雪堆成的人形雪人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 8th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: In trigonometry, the Greek letter theta is commonly used as a variable to represent an unknown angle.
examples.zh: 在三角学中，希腊字母西塔通常用作表示未知角的变量。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于数学、物理或金融工程等专业语境，指希腊字母θ，常表示角位移、未定角度或期权的时间损耗率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 theta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 笨重的, 麻烦的, 累赘的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to handle or use especially because of size or weight

examples.en: The old administrative system was replaced because it was too slow and cumbersome.
examples.zh: 原有的行政管理体系被撤换了，因为它过于缓慢且繁琐冗长。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指物体“笨重不易搬运”，也可引申指流程、体制“繁琐复杂的”，常修饰package、system或procedure。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cumbersome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prolonged disorder of eating due to loss of appetite

examples.en: She struggled with anorexia for several years before finally seeking professional help.
examples.zh: 在最终寻求专业帮助之前，她与厌食症抗争了数年。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，医学上指食欲缺乏，日常语境多指神经性厌食症（anorexia nervosa），常与suffer from搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 患神经性厌食症的; 食欲缺乏的; 厌食的; 简洁的
lemmas.def_en: suffering from anorexia nervosa; pathologically thin

examples.en: Doctors were deeply concerned about the anorexic patient's dangerously low body weight.
examples.zh: 医生们对这位厌食症患者极低的危险体重深感担忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anorexia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏远, 离间, 转让
lemmas.def_en: the feeling of being alienated from other people

examples.en: Many young people in big cities experience a profound sense of alienation from society.
examples.zh: 大城市中的许多年轻人都对社会产生了一种深切的疏离感。

lemmas.usage_note: 抽象名词，常与介词from连用，指人与社会、家庭在情感上的疏离或隔阂，学术语境亦指哲学术语“异化”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alienation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闪锌矿；扑克牌的二十一点；包革金属棍棒
lemmas.def_en: a common scrubby deciduous tree of central and southeastern United States having dark bark and broad three-lobed (club-shaped) leaves; tends to form dense thickets

examples.en: He sat at the casino table and spent hours playing blackjack with the other tourists.
examples.zh: 他坐在赌桌旁，和其他游客一起玩了几个小时的二十一点扑克牌。

lemmas.usage_note: 作纸牌游戏时不可数，常与play搭配；指包革短棍或矿物时为可数名词，语境依据具体领域而定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blackjack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the blood flowing through the circulatory system

examples.en: The vaccine is designed to release antibodies directly into the bloodstream to fight infections.
examples.zh: 该疫苗旨在直接向血流中释放抗体以对抗感染。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作单数，指人体内循环流动的血液，极常与介词into或enter连用，多见于医学与健康语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodstream 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 六月禾, 早熟禾熟植物
lemmas.def_en: any of various grasses of the genus Poa

examples.en: The festival features traditional American folk music, with a strong focus on energetic bluegrass.
examples.zh: 该音乐节以传统美国民谣为特色，重点展示了极富活力的蓝草音乐。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，一指禾本科草类（早熟禾），更常用于音乐领域指源自美国南方的“蓝草音乐”，常作定语或主语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluegrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of molecular biology that studies the use of microorganisms to perform specific industrial processes

examples.en: She decided to invest a significant portion of her savings in promising biotech startups.
examples.zh: 她决定将很大一部分积蓄投资于有发展前景的生物技术初创公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 为biotechnology的口语及商业常用简称，常与industry、firm搭配，泛指生物技术领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biotech 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cognitive state in which you act without self-awareness

examples.en: Exhausted after the night shift, he drove home almost entirely on autopilot.
examples.zh: 上完夜班精疲力竭的他，几乎完全是凭下意识的惯性开车回家的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于航空及科技语境，比喻用法常见于短语on autopilot，表示“无意识地、习惯性地行动”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autopilot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fabric dyed with splotches of green and brown and black and tan; intended to make the wearer of a garment made of this fabric hard to distinguish from the background

examples.en: The hunters blended into the dense autumn forest by wearing green and brown camo.
examples.zh: 猎人们穿戴着绿褐相间的迷彩服，隐蔽在茂密的秋日森林中。

lemmas.usage_note: camouflage的非正式口语缩写，常指迷彩服或迷彩图案，常作不可数名词或修饰语使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence

examples.en: Thanks to her astute business instincts, the company avoided a major financial crisis.
examples.zh: 多亏了她敏锐的商业直觉，公司才避免了一场重大的财务危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义词，指具有敏锐洞察力和准确判断力，常修饰investor、observer、move等词。

lemmas.def_en: in a shrewd manner

examples.en: he invested his fortune astutely
he was acutely insightful

lemmas.def_zh: 敏锐, 精明, 狡猾
lemmas.def_en: intelligence manifested by being astute (as in business dealings)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧身褡, 妇女的胸衣
lemmas.def_en: a woman's close-fitting foundation garment

examples.en: Victorian women often wore a tightly laced corset beneath their elaborate dresses.
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代的女性常常在华丽的连衣裙内穿一件系得很紧的束身胸衣。

lemmas.usage_note: 指塑形紧身胸衣或医用护腰支架，可数名词，常与wear、lace搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: dress with a corset

examples.en: The outdated regulations severely corset the creative freedom of young developers.
examples.zh: 这些过时的规章制度严重束缚了年轻开发者的创作自由。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词表示“用紧身褡束缚”，引申为“严密限制、束缚”，多用于被动语态或比喻语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corset 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a false statement

examples.en: The spokesperson was accused of deliberately uttering a falsehood during the press conference.
examples.zh: 该发言人被指控在新闻发布会上故意说谎。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，既可作不可数名词表示“虚假性”，也可作可数名词表示具体的“谎言”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 falsehood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奥利奥（商标名）；讨好白人的黑人
lemmas.def_en: chocolate cookie with white cream filling

examples.en: He twisted open the Oreo and licked the sweet cream filling first.
examples.zh: 他扭开奥利奥饼干，先舔了舔里面甜甜的奶油夹心。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母大写时指夹心饼干商标；小写且用于指人时为高度冒犯性俚语，含有贬义，须谨慎使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oreo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rule adopted by an organization in order to regulate its own affairs and the behavior of its members

examples.en: The municipal council passed a new bylaw restricting excessive noise after midnight.
examples.zh: 市政委员会通过了一项限制午夜后过度噪音的新附则条例。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律及行政用语，常指地方规章或机构章程附则，常用复数形式bylaws。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bylaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使变斜视眼；斜视, 倾向, 斜行
lemmas.def_en: cross one's eyes as if in strabismus

examples.en: She had to squint through the dense fog to read the roadside sign.
examples.zh: 她不得不眯起眼睛穿透浓雾，去辨认路边的标牌。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词多表示“眯起眼睛看”，常与介词at或into搭配；亦可表示“患斜视”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very wealthy or powerful businessman

examples.en: The shipping magnate donated millions of dollars to fund medical research institutes.
examples.zh: 这位航运业巨头捐赠了数百万美元以资助医学研究机构。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在商业、工业界有巨大权势和财富的巨头，常见搭配如media magnate、real estate magnate。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magnate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不在犯罪现场, 托辞
lemmas.def_en: (law) a defense by an accused person purporting to show that he or she could not have committed the crime in question

examples.en: The suspect had a solid alibi, proving he was dining with friends during the robbery.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人有确凿的不在场证明，证实案发时他正与朋友共进晚餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于法律或口语语境，常与 provide, establish 或 have 连用，指不在犯罪现场的证据或借口。

lemmas.def_en: exonerate by means of an alibi

examples.en: His colleague agreed to alibi him, claiming they were working late at the office.
examples.zh: 他的同事同意为他作伪证开脱，声称他们当时在办公室加班。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式及法律口语中作及物动词使用，意为“为……提供不在场证明”或“为某人/某事辩解”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alibi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: opposed to war

examples.en: She remained deeply committed to her pacifist principles even during wartime.
examples.zh: 即使在战时，她依然坚定地恪守自己的和平主义原则。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰 beliefs, movement, stance 等词，强调反对战争或暴力的和平主义原则与性质。

lemmas.def_en: opposed to war

lemmas.def_zh: 和平主义者, 反战论者, 不抵抗主义者
lemmas.def_en: someone opposed to violence as a means of settling disputes

examples.en: As a lifelong pacifist, he refused to bear arms and served as a medic instead.
examples.zh: 作为一名终身和平主义者，他拒绝拿起武器，转而担任医护兵。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指反对一切战争及暴力手段的和平主义者，常与 lifelong, devout 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 和平主义, 反战论, 不抵抗主义
lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that all violence is unjustifiable

examples.en: His deep commitment to pacifism prevented him from joining the military during the war.
examples.zh: 他对和平主义的坚定信念使他未在战时参军。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pacifist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ship powered by one or more steam engines

examples.en: In the nineteenth century, the steamship revolutionized transatlantic passenger travel.
examples.zh: 在19世纪，蒸汽轮船彻底改变了横跨大西洋的客运方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 常缩写为 S.S.，指以蒸汽机为动力的轮船，多用于历史叙事或航运业正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steamship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the writing point of a pen

examples.en: He pressed the gold nib gently against the textured paper to test the ink flow.
examples.zh: 他将金笔尖轻轻压在有纹理的纸上，以测试墨水的流畅度。

lemmas.usage_note: 指钢笔尖、鸭嘴笔笔尖，常用搭配如 fountain pen nib，书写及文具用品领域的高频词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 主义, 学说, 制度
lemmas.def_en: a belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school

examples.en: Voters grew tired of the endless political isms that failed to solve real problems.
examples.zh: 选民对那些无法解决实际问题、层出不穷的政治主义感到厌倦。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词使用，多带轻蔑或批判语气体，泛指教条式的各种学说、主义或意识形态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 特权, 君权, 职权
lemmas.def_en: a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)

examples.en: It is the committee's prerogative to accept or reject any application without explanation.
examples.zh: 委员会有权接受或驳回任何申请，且无需给出解释。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语高频词，多与 royal, executive 或 personal 搭配，指特定身份享有的排他性特权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prerogative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无人情味的, 薄情的, 残忍的
lemmas.def_en: lacking and reflecting lack of pity or compassion

examples.en: Human rights advocates condemned the prison's overcrowded cells as inhumane.
examples.zh: 人权倡导者谴责该监狱过度拥挤的牢房极度缺乏人道。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常修饰 conditions, treatment, punishment，形容缺乏人道关怀、冷酷残忍的行为。

lemmas.def_en: in an inhumane manner

examples.en: the prisoners of war were treated inhumanely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inhumane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner

examples.en: The young chess grandmaster managed to win five consecutive games in the tourney.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的国际象棋特级大师在这场锦标赛中连胜五局。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指中世纪骑士比武，亦可作为口语或体育新闻中 tournament 的简称，意为锦标赛。

lemmas.def_en: engage in a tourney

examples.en: Knights from distant realms traveled for weeks to tourney before the king.
examples.zh: 来自远方国度的骑士们跋涉数周，只为在国王面前参加比武大会。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或文学用语中作不及物动词，指参加比武竞赛，现代罕用于指参赛交手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tourney 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回旋, 卷绕, 盘旋
lemmas.def_en: curl, wind, or twist together

examples.en: The author tended to convolute the plot by introducing unnecessary subplots.
examples.zh: 作者由于引入了不必要的支线情节，导致整个故事线变得错综复杂。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词时常表示使思想、剧情或逻辑变得错综复杂，也可作不及物动词指盘旋缠绕。

lemmas.def_zh: 回旋, 卷绕, 盘旋
lemmas.def_en: the shape of something rotating rapidly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 convolute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of philosophy concerned with the law and the principles that lead courts to make the decisions they do

examples.en: Recent environmental rulings have significantly reshaped the nation's jurisprudence.
examples.zh: 近期关于环境法的多项裁决深刻地重塑了该国的法理体系。

lemmas.usage_note: 法学与学术正式用语，不可数，指法理学、法哲学，或指特定法系、法院的判例法体系。

lemmas.def_zh: 法学家, 法律学者, 法律著作家
lemmas.def_en: a legal scholar versed in civil law or the law of nations

examples.en: The distinguished jurist published a comprehensive analysis of the nation's new constitutional law.
examples.zh: 这位著名的法学家发表了一篇关于该国新宪法的全面分析。

lemmas.def_zh: 法律学的, 法律学上的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the science or philosophy of law or a system of laws

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jurisprudence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 腮须, 胡须, 一丝儿
lemmas.def_en: a very small distance or space

examples.en: The cat twitched its whiskers nervously as it watched the bird through the window.
examples.zh: 猫隔着窗户盯着那只鸟，紧张地抖动着胡须。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指猫狗等动物的胡须（复数）或人颊上的胡子；习语 by a whisker 表示“险胜”或“差一点点”。

lemmas.def_en: furnish with whiskers

examples.en: The tin plating on electronic components may whisker over time, causing potential short circuits.
examples.zh: 电子元器件表面的镀锡层随着时间的推移可能会长出晶须，从而引发潜在的短路隐患。

lemmas.usage_note: 在材料科学与冶金中作动词，指金属表面“长出微晶/晶须”，为高度专业的工业与技术用语。

lemmas.def_zh: 有连鬓胡子的, 有须的
lemmas.def_en: having hair on the cheeks and chin

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whisker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 征服, 使服从, 抑制, 克制
lemmas.def_en: put down by force or intimidation

examples.en: The imperial army sought to subjugate the neighboring tribes and bring them under total control.
examples.zh: 帝国军队企图征服周边部落，将其置于完全的控制之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，正式语体，常用于政治、历史或心理语境，表示“彻底征服、强行统治或抑制欲望”。

lemmas.def_zh: 征服, 镇压, 平息
lemmas.def_en: forced submission to control by others

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subjugate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: turn away from by persuasion

examples.en: Her family tried hard to dissuade her from quitting her stable job to start a company.
examples.zh: 家人极力劝阻她辞去稳定的工作去开公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，固定搭配为 dissuade sb. from (doing) sth.，表示通过劝说说服某人放弃计划。

lemmas.def_en: deterring from action

examples.en: dissuasive advice
made a slight dissuasive gesture with her hand

lemmas.def_zh: 劝阻, 劝戒, 谏诤
lemmas.def_en: a communication that dissuades you

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissuade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: do without or cease to hold or adhere to

examples.en: She decided to forgo her annual vacation to finish writing her doctoral thesis.
examples.zh: 为了完成博士论文的撰写，她决定放弃休年假。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，及物动词，后接名词或动名词，意为为了更重要的目的而“自愿放弃”权益或享乐。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有也行, 放弃( forgo的过去分词 )
lemmas.def_en: do without or cease to hold or adhere to

examples.en: We are dispensing with formalities
relinquish the old ideas

lemmas.def_en: do without or cease to hold or adhere to

examples.en: We are dispensing with formalities
relinquish the old ideas

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forgo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公用场地；有树丛的开阔草地
lemmas.def_en: a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property

examples.en: The historic manor is surrounded by miles of lush, rolling parkland.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的庄园被数英里郁郁葱葱、连绵起伏的公园绿地所环抱。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或集合名词，常与 acres of、rolling 等连用，指风景如画的开阔林地或公园绿地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parkland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 作辗轧声, 发出辗轧声
lemmas.def_en: make a high-pitched, screeching noise

examples.en: The old wooden stairs creaked loudly under his heavy footsteps.
examples.zh: 陈旧的木楼梯在他沉重的脚步下发出刺耳的嘎吱声。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作不及物动词，指门、木地板或机械因老化、承重而“发出吱呀/嘎吱的尖锐摩擦声”。

lemmas.def_en: worn and broken down by hard use

examples.en: a creaky shack
a decrepit bus...its seats held together with friction tape

family_guide.root_logic: 以 creak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 撅嘴, 生气, 条鳕
lemmas.def_en: a disdainful grimace

examples.en: The little girl wore a grumpy pout after her mother refused to buy the toy.
examples.zh: 在妈妈拒绝给她买玩具后，小女孩满脸不悦地撅着嘴。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指“撅嘴”的动作或恼怒的神态，常见搭配如 have a pout 或 wear a pout。

lemmas.def_zh: 撅嘴生气的人, 球胸鸽
lemmas.def_en: someone with a habitually sullen or gloomy expression
be in a huff and display one's displeasure

examples.en: Stop pouting about losing the game and focus on practicing for the next one.
examples.zh: 别再为输掉比赛撅嘴赌气了，专心为下一场训练吧。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指因生气、撒娇或摆姿势而“撅起嘴唇”，口语与日常书面中均十分常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 切去头端, 缩短, 截棱, 使成平面
lemmas.def_en: replace a corner by a plane

examples.en: The software will automatically truncate long filenames to prevent system errors.
examples.zh: 该软件会自动截断过长的文件名，以防止系统报错。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于科技、数据处理或正式文本中，指“截断、缩减”数据、篇幅或工期。

lemmas.def_zh: 切掉顶端, 截头, 截短
lemmas.def_en: the property of being truncated or short

family_guide.root_logic: 以 truncate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可防止的, 可阻止的, 可预防的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being prevented; - A.L.Guerard

examples.en: Vaccines have significantly reduced the global spread of preventable diseases.
examples.zh: 疫苗显著降低了全球范围内各类可预防疾病的传播。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语或表语形容词，高频搭配 preventable disease/accident/death，多见于公共卫生与安全管理。

lemmas.def_en: not preventable

examples.en: unpreventable hysteria

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preventable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中心装饰品；放在餐桌中央的摆饰
lemmas.def_en: the central or most important feature

examples.en: A beautiful arrangement of fresh flowers served as the centerpiece of the banquet table.
